search_metadata.evidence_digest:
EVIDENCE DIGEST: IMH 224 (maize)
Variety name (CSC minutes) and Seednet name are both "IMH 224", so the evidence applies to both names.

STRESS TOLERANCE
No evidence found. None of the captured pages reports drought, heat, salinity, flood or submergence tolerance for IMH 224.

DISEASE AND PEST
- A Marathi-language launch article says that the set of ICAR-IIMR hybrids it lists, including IMH-224, carries a low chance of pest and disease attack; this is a general press claim, not a trial result -- https://hellokrushi.com/icar-iimr-launches-4-new-hybrid-varieties-of-maize-beneficial-for-farmers/

AGRONOMY AND TRIALS
- The VIT Vellore organic-cultivation study grew IMH 224 among eight maize genotypes, and it reports phenotypic, yield and canopy data for them; the IMH 224 values were not captured -- https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC11883377/
- The same article's data set includes IMH 224 kernel-weight data (total kernel weight 163.00 g in the table row captured) in a machine-learning study that uses it as a genotype; this is a dataset value, not a field-trial result -- https://www.frontiersin.org/journals/artificial-intelligence/articles/10.3389/frai.2026.1742033/xml
- A Marathi-language launch article gives a yield claim of more than 95 quintals per hectare for the listed hybrids, IMH-224 included; this is a promotional claim, not a verified trial mean -- https://hellokrushi.com/icar-iimr-launches-4-new-hybrid-varieties-of-maize-beneficial-for-farmers/

GENETICS AND QTL
- No evidence found for QTL or marker studies on IMH 224. The parentage in the request (female IML 22; male BML 16) was supplied by the user and was not confirmed by any search result.

BREEDER AND INSTITUTION
- The 2022 IIMR annual report lists IMH 224 among the three field-corn hybrids (with IMH 222 and IMH 223) developed, produced and commercialised in 2022 -- https://www.iimr.res.in/frontend/images/publications/annual_reports/2022/annual_report_2022.pdf
- Developing institution: ICAR-Indian Institute of Maize Research (IIMR), Ludhiana, Punjab. Source for the institute: https://iimr.res.in/technologies/maize-hybrids
- No breeder or scientist name was found for IMH 224 in the captured results.

CONTACT DETAILS
- Institute: ICAR-Indian Institute of Maize Research (IIMR), Ludhiana -- https://iimr.res.in/technologies/maize-hybrids
- Official institute website: https://iimr.res.in
- Breeder name, email, phone and postal address for the division: No evidence found.

PUBLICATIONS
- Authors not captured (2026). Machine-learning study using IMH 224 kernel-weight data (Frontiers in Artificial Intelligence). -- https://www.frontiersin.org/journals/artificial-intelligence/articles/10.3389/frai.2026.1742033/xml ; DOI 10.3389/frai.2026.1742033
- Authors not captured (year not captured). Characterizing diverse maize varieties under organic cultivation: phenotypic, yield, and canopy data from VIT Vellore (includes IMH 224). Journal not captured. -- https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC11883377/
- ICAR-IIMR (2022). Annual Report 2022 (IMH 222, IMH 223, IMH 224 produced and commercialised). ICAR-IIMR, Ludhiana. -- https://www.iimr.res.in/frontend/images/publications/annual_reports/2022/annual_report_2022.pdf
- No AICRP/ICAR trial report, KrishiKosh thesis or peer-reviewed variety-release paper naming IMH 224 was found.

SEED AVAILABILITY
- The VIT Vellore study says its IMH-series seed was purchased from IIMR (Punjab) -- https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC11883377/
- A Hindi-language article gives MoU counts for IMH 224 with seed companies, reported as 5 (the article lists 6, 5 and 2 for LQMH 1, IMH 224 and IQMH 203 in that order) -- https://www.kisanofindia.com/latest-news/icar-iimr-hybrid-maize-seeds-for-farmers/48234
- No Seednet listing, NSC/State Seed Corporation, KVK or SAU seed-sale page for IMH 224 was found.

RECOMMENDED STATES
- No evidence found. The search results do not confirm the states given in the request (Eastern UP, Bihar, Jharkhand, Odisha). Treat them as unverified input and check the CSC minutes or Seednet notification.

NOTE ON THIS SEARCH
- Four web_search queries were run: variety and release, breeder/institute, research, and seed availability. A fifth call hit the tool-use limit, so the contact, breeder and trial gaps above could not be followed up. The search-result pages cited above are the only sources.
- The searches did not return the official Seednet or CSC notification page for IMH 224.
- The IIMR maize-hybrids page appeared in results, but the captured text did not include the IMH 224 entry, so it is cited only as the institute source.
- Hindi and Marathi news articles are secondary sources; their yield and pest-resistance claims should be checked against IIMR or CSC documents.

drought.details: The digest found no evidence on drought tolerance for this variety. The original CSC/input variety record states 'Tolerance to rainfed environment' and suitability for both irrigated and rainfed kharif environments. This is a general rainfed-adaptation statement, not a drought-specific test result, and it is not sourced from the digest, so no drought level is assigned.

heat.details: No evidence found in the digest for heat tolerance.

salinity.details: No evidence found in the digest for salinity tolerance.

flood.details: No evidence found in the digest for flood tolerance. The developer page reports tolerance to lodging and retention of green foliage at harvest, which does not address flooding.

disease_resistance.summary: Maydis leaf blight (MLB): The developer product page (JK Agri Genetics) states the hybrid is tolerant to MLB but is challenged by post-flowering turcicum leaf blight (TLB) and stalk rot. The original CSC/input record states high resistance to Maydis leaf blight and charcoal rot compared with check hybrids, and moderate resistance under artificially created epiphytotic conditions at 3 hot-spots during 2016-2018. These two sources conflict, particularly on stalk rot and TLB, and the CSC claims are not confirmed by a digest source. Charcoal rot (CLS/RDM notations): the ICAR-IIMR Kharif Maize 2016 AICRP report lists JKMH 4152 in a DUS/disease table with notations MLB, CLS, BSR and RDM, but the table is garbled and the zone-to-notation mapping could not be confirmed, so this is indicative only. Turcicum leaf blight and stalk rot: challenged per developer page (susceptibility, not resistance).

pest_resistance.summary: Digest: no evidence found for insect pest resistance. Original CSC/input record (not sourced from the digest): the proposed hybrid is as tolerant as checks against Chilo partellus (stem borer). This is a parity-with-checks statement, not a demonstrated resistance level.

agronomic_details.yield: Conflicting values. Developer product page (digest): yield potential 65-70 q/ha. Original CSC/input record: average yield 85.00 to 95.00 kg/ha, which appears to be a unit or transcription inconsistency with the developer figure and should be verified. Shelling 80-82% (developer page).
agronomic_details.stability: Developer page: tolerant to lodging and retains green foliage at harvest. Original input record: resistance to lodging. No multi-environment stability data found in the digest.
agronomic_details.adaptation: Original CSC/input record: North West Plain Zone (NWPZ) of the AICRP on Maize, suitable for irrigated and rainfed kharif environments, with higher yield expected in silt loam and black soils. The IIMR cultivars page lists adaptation only as zone codes 'UK, AS, NEPZ' without expansion. Digest does not independently confirm the NWPZ fit.
agronomic_details.maturity_days: Conflicting values. Developer product page (digest): full-maturity kharif hybrid, 110-115 days. Original CSC/input record: 94 to 96 days. The discrepancy is unresolved.
agronomic_details.plant_characteristics: Developer page (digest): uniform semi-erect, medium-tall plant type; medium-high placed conical cobs with white shank, fully covered by husk; orange-yellow, semi-dent, medium-bold kernels. Original CSC/input record: orange kernel colour with cap on top of kernel; conico-cylindrical ear.
agronomic_details.field_trials: (1) ICAR-IIMR Kharif Maize 2016 AICRP report: JKMH 4152 appears in a DUS testing/disease table; the zone-level results are garbled and could not be read reliably. (2) Original CSC/input record: under artificially created epiphytotic conditions at 3 hot-spots during 2016-2018, the variety showed moderate resistance to Maydis leaf blight and charcoal rot, with high resistance compared with check hybrids reported for these diseases. No yield trial data, multi-location results, or fodder-specific trials were found in the digest.

search_metadata.evidence_digest:
EVIDENCE DIGEST: JKMH 4152 (seednet name: JKMH 4152 (JKMH 8008)), Maize

Name note: The CSC/IIMR listing uses "JKMH 4152 (JKMH 8008)". The JK Agri Genetics product page uses "JKMH 4152(8008)". Every finding below matches either name. Seednet.gov.in was not reached by any of the four searches, so no Seednet-portal evidence was found under the "Maize (fodder)" crop label.

STRESS TOLERANCE
- Tolerant to lodging and retains green foliage at harvest, according to the developer's product page -- https://jkagri.com/product/jkmh-8008-suitable-for-kharif-seasons/
- Drought, heat, salinity, flood and submergence tolerance: No evidence found. The searches returned no page giving these traits for this variety.

DISEASE AND PEST
- Tolerant to MLB (maize leaf blight), but the developer's page says it is challenged by post-flowering TLB (turcicum leaf blight) and stalk rot -- https://jkagri.com/product/jkmh-8008-suitable-for-kharif-seasons/
- The ICAR-IIMR Kharif Maize 2016 AICRP report lists JKMH 4152 in a DUS/disease table with notations MLB, CLS, BSR and RDM. The table is garbled, so I could not confirm which notation sits in which zone column. Treat this as indicative only -- https://aicmip.naarm.org.in/AnnualReports/Maize%20AICRP%20REPORT%20KHARIF%202016.pdf
- Insect pest resistance: No evidence found.

AGRONOMY AND TRIALS
- Full-maturity kharif hybrid, 110-115 days, with a yield potential of 65-70 q/ha and shelling of 80-82% -- https://jkagri.com/product/jkmh-8008-suitable-for-kharif-seasons/
- Plant type: uniform semi-erect, medium-tall; cobs are medium-high placed, conical, with white shank, fully covered by husk; kernels are orange-yellow, semi-dent, medium-bold -- https://jkagri.com/product/jkmh-8008-suitable-for-kharif-seasons/
- Multi-location or field trial data: No evidence found beyond the DUS testing entry in the 2016 AICRP report (https://aicmip.naarm.org.in/AnnualReports/Maize%20AICRP%20REPORT%20KHARIF%202016.pdf).
- Fodder-specific agronomy or yield: No evidence found. Nothing retrieved describes this variety as a fodder maize.

GENETICS AND QTL (genes, parentage, breeding-line codes, breeding method, genome resources)
- Parentage JMZ0416 x JMZ0408 (both from JK Agri Genetics proprietary germplasm): No evidence found in search results. This comes only from the input record and could not be verified.
- Breeding-line codes: The AICRP 2016 report gives the IIMR code IMR113 for JKMH 4152 -- https://aicmip.naarm.org.in/AnnualReports/Maize%20AICRP%20REPORT%20KHARIF%202016.pdf
- Breeding method, QTL/marker studies, genome resources: No evidence found.

BREEDER AND INSTITUTION
- Lead breeder name(s): No evidence found. No search result named a breeder for this variety.
- Developing institution: JK Agri Genetics Limited (listed as "JK AgriGenetics", private sector). Release record: https://iimr.icar.gov.in/cultivars-2/
- Testing context: ICAR-IIMR acts as nodal centre for DUS testing of maize, and JKMH 4152 appears in its 2016 report -- https://aicmip.naarm.org.in/AnnualReports/Maize%20AICRP%20REPORT%20KHARIF%202016.pdf
- Station/division: No evidence found.

CONTACT DETAILS
- Institute address (JK Agri Genetics Limited, 1-10-177, 4th floor, Varun Towers, Begumpet, Hyderabad - 500016) -- https://jkagri.com/product-category/field-crops/maize/
- Official email, phone or contact page for the company: No evidence found in the retrieved pages.
- Breeder contact: No evidence found.

PUBLICATIONS
- No evidence found. The searches returned no peer-reviewed paper, AICRP entry for this variety beyond the 2016 report listing, KrishiKosh thesis, or conference paper naming JKMH 4152 or JKMH 8008. RECOMMENDED STATES
- The IIMR cultivars record lists the adaptation as "UK, AS, NEPZ", which are zone codes rather than state names; the page does not expand them -- https://iimr.icar.gov.in/cultivars-2/
- The state list from the input record (Punjab, Haryana, Delhi, Uttarakhand, Assam, Western UP) could not be verified by search. The JK product page does not state any states.

official_quote.quote: Under artificial created epipphytotic conditions at 3 hot-spots during 2016-2018, it has shown moderately resistance reaction to Maydis Leaf Blight, charcoal rot

disease_resistance.research_summary: Maydis leaf blight (MLB): The developer product page (JK Agri Genetics) states the hybrid is tolerant to MLB but is challenged by post-flowering turcicum leaf blight (TLB) and stalk rot. The original CSC/input record states high resistance to Maydis leaf blight and charcoal rot compared with check hybrids, and moderate resistance under artificially created epiphytotic conditions at 3 hot-spots during 2016-2018. These two sources conflict, particularly on stalk rot and TLB, and the CSC claims are not confirmed by a digest source. Charcoal rot (CLS/RDM notations): the ICAR-IIMR Kharif Maize 2016 AICRP report lists JKMH 4152 in a DUS/disease table with notations MLB, CLS, BSR and RDM, but the table is garbled and the zone-to-notation mapping could not be confirmed, so this is indicative only. Turcicum leaf blight and stalk rot: challenged per developer page (susceptibility, not resistance).

seednet_fields.Parentage: 1.	One Hundred ninely Six Lines of Chh-215 were sown as female. Bulk seed was used as male in half programme with selections between and within lines. Selected female cobs were grown in sibbing was made within line. 2.	Finally, cobs from healthy plants with desirable characteristics features were selected and grown in 4 rows plots High yielding lines were selected and bulk population have been made which is designated as CHH-215 and are being maintained by half sib methods.
seednet_fields.Adaptation and recommended ecology: Rainfed condition, kharif and Irrigated in Summer.
seednet_fields.Agronomic Features: It is highly responsive to fertilizer doses up to 100 kg nitrogen/ha during kharif but in zaid, it has better response up to 120 kg nitrogen/ha with appropriate P and K combination.
seednet_fields.General Morphological Characteristics: Green foliage and early maturing.

search_metadata.evidence_digest:
EVIDENCE DIGEST: KDM-438 (Maize)

Name note: the CSC release-minute name and the Seednet name are both "KDM-438", so every item below refers to the same string. No Seednet portal page was retrieved, and no CSC release minutes were found. The four searches returned only one page that names this variety.

STRESS TOLERANCE: No evidence found. The searches returned drought, cold and density-tolerance studies on other maize varieties (XY335, KH8, CanSen 001), none naming KDM-438. -- https://www.nature.com/articles/s41598-018-35275-w ; https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/41681680/ ; https://nation.africa/kenya/health/researchers-develop-new-drought-tolerant-maize-variety-4362474

DISEASE AND PEST: No evidence found. -- Searches of KDM-438 maize returned no disease or pest reaction data for this variety.

AGRONOMY AND TRIALS: One table row lists KDM-438 with the entry "SKUAS & T, Srinagar", "Jammu & Kashmir (Kharif)", a value of 6.0 in an unlabelled column, and "Orange-yellow, flint" grain. The column heading for the 6.0 value is not visible, so it is not confirmed as yield. The same table lists a 'Medium maturity' category for other varieties; no maturity value is attributed to KDM-438. -- https://www.researchgate.net/publication/290428916_benchmarking_indian_maize_varieties

GENETICS AND QTL (genes, parentage, breeding-line codes, breeding method, genome resources): No evidence found. Parentage and breeding method were not found. The ICAR 2013-14 report that mentions Jammu and Kashmir maize lists "Shalimar Maize" and does not name KDM-438. -- https://icar.org.in/sites/default/files/inline-files/crop-improvement-AR-2013-14.pdf

BREEDER AND INSTITUTION: The only institution found is SKUAS&T Srinagar, from the table row above, which gives it as the source for KDM-438. No breeder or scientist name is tied to KDM-438 in any retrieved page. The people listed as authors of the benchmarking presentation (Jyoti Kaul, Bhupender Kumar, O.P. Yadav) are not linked to KDM-438 in the snippet, so they are not attributed here. -- https://www.researchgate.net/publication/290428916_benchmarking_indian_maize_varieties

CONTACT DETAILS: No evidence found. No email, phone, postal address or contact page for SKUAS&T Srinagar's maize programme or for any KDM-438 breeder was retrieved. The SKUAS&T official website was not found in the searches. -- No URL found.

PUBLICATIONS:
Kaul, J.; Kumar, B.; Yadav, O.P. (year not stated). Benchmarking Indian maize varieties (conference presentation, special meeting on benchmarking agricultural and horticultural crops in India, Karnal). Source: ResearchGate -- https://www.researchgate.net/publication/290428916_benchmarking_indian_maize_varieties
Note: this item contains the KDM-438 table row. The authors are the presentation's listed authors, not confirmed as KDM-438 breeders. No DOI was found.
No KrishiKosh thesis, peer-reviewed paper, AICRP annual report entry, or QTL/marker study naming KDM-438 was found.

SEED AVAILABILITY: No evidence found. No NSC, state seed corporation, KVK, SKUAS&T seed sale or dealer listing for KDM-438 was retrieved.

RECOMMENDED STATES: Jammu & Kashmir (Kharif), per the benchmarking table row only. -- https://www.researchgate.net/publication/290428916_benchmarking_indian_maize_varieties

disease_resistance.summary: Not found in searched sources. The digest contains no evidence for resistance to wilt, leaf curl, bacterial blight or other diseases in AKH-9916. The CSC record lists disease reaction as 'Not Specified'.

pest_resistance.summary: No pest resistance rating was found. Leafhopper (Cicadellidae): in an organic cotton study (2019-2021), AKH-9916 had among the lowest leafhopper counts at 30 DAS (0.49/leaf) and is listed with an 'HV' code. The paper's interpretation of the HV code was not captured, so this is an observed count and not a confirmed resistance rating. Leafhopper (Amrasca devastans): the host-plant-resistance study reports higher trichome density for AKH 9916 among parental lines. This is a morphological trait and not a resistance rating. Bollworm complex: the PDKV Akola 2016-17 ready-mix insecticide trial used AKH 9916 as a test variety; it is an insecticide study and contains no resistance finding. The CSC record lists pest reaction as 'Not Specified'.

agronomic_details.yield: CSC record: average yield 6658.00 to 7149.00 Kg/Ha (CSC is the ground truth). The digest found no field-trial yield values for AKH-9916 in Maharashtra. This is a comparison against AKH-09-5 and is not a yield figure for AKH-9916.
agronomic_details.stability: A multi-environment stability study found AKH 9916 showed average stability with average seed cotton yield. The trial location and zone were not captured in the snippet.
agronomic_details.adaptation: Maharashtra, rainfed and irrigated cotton systems as tested in the digest (PDKV trials, Maharashtra locations). genetics_and_breeding.genetic_markers: Not found in searched sources. The digest reports no SNP, SSR or marker data for AKH-9916. Parentage per the CSC record is KML-322 x KML-132, KML-09; the digest found no independent evidence for this parentage.
genetics_and_breeding.qtl_information: Not found in searched sources. No QTL effects were captured. search_metadata.evidence_digest:
AKH-9916 (cotton) EVIDENCE DIGEST

NAME NOTE: "AKH-9916" (CSC name, cotton) is the name used in all findings below. The Seednet name "KH-5991" (listed as MAIZE) returned only a maize list entry, which is discarded under STRICT RELEVANCE. The Seednet record is unresolved and needs manual checking.

STRESS TOLERANCE
- Under rainfed Maharashtra trials, AKH-9916 was a check; the paper reports its canopy temperature at 50% flowering as 28.3 °C and at 50% boll bursting as 29.09 °C, versus 26.82 °C and 27.37 °C for AKH 09-5. No drought, heat, salinity, flood or submergence tolerance rating for AKH-9916 itself was found. -- https://krishikosh.egranth.ac.in/server/api/core/bitstreams/7db0e355-40c6-4531-8e92-02d5ee3bb937/content
- Drought, heat, salinity, flood and submergence: No evidence found for AKH-9916 specifically.

DISEASE AND PEST
- In an organic cotton study (2019–2021), AKH-9916 had among the lowest Cicadellidae (leafhopper) counts at 30 DAS (0.49/leaf), and it is listed as "HV" type; the paper's own interpretation of the HV code was not captured. -- https://doi.org/10.3390/agriculture13071402
- A leafhopper (Amrasca devastans) host-plant-resistance study reports AKH 9916 had higher trichome density among parental lines; this is a morphological trait, not a resistance rating. -- https://www.researchgate.net/publication/280021623_Host_plant_resistance_in_cotton_accessions_to_the_leafhopper_Amrasca_devastans_Distant
- Bollworm complex: a PDKV Akola 2016-17 trial of ready-mix insecticides used AKH 9916 as the test variety; this is an insecticide study, not a resistance finding. -- https://www.ijcmas.com/special/6/B.S.%20Borude,%20et%20al.pdf
- Disease resistance (wilt, leaf curl, bacterial blight, etc.): No evidence found.

AGRONOMY AND TRIALS
- Duration: PDKV Cotton Research Unit describes AKH-9916 as a medium-duration variety of 170-180 days. -- https://www.researchgate.net/publication/346478149_AKH-09-5_A_promising_American_cotton_genotype_for_rainfed_cultivation_of_Maharashtra
- Yield: In PDKV university multi-location varietal trials (2012-2016), AKH-09-5 outyielded checks including AKH-9916 by 29.7% (seed cotton) and 17.9% (lint); this is a comparison of AKH-09-5 against AKH-9916, not a yield figure for AKH-9916 itself. -- https://www.researchgate.net/publication/346478149_AKH-09-5_A_promising_American_cotton_genotype_for_rainfed_cultivation_of_Maharashtra
- Yield stability: A multi-environment stability study found AKH 9916 showed average stability with average seed cotton yield; the trial location and zone were not captured in the snippet. -- https://www.crdaindia.com/downloads/files/n531e9e04afcd7.pdf
- Plant height and leaf area in 2018-19 kharif rainfed spacing trial: AKH 9916 had plant height 95.92 cm and leaf area 16.07 dm²/plant at 50% flowering, below AKH 09-5. -- https://krishikosh.egranth.ac.in/server/api/core/bitstreams/7db0e355-40c6-4531-8e92-02d5ee3bb937/content
- Teak-belt agroforestry trial (2022): AKH-9916 was one of three upland cotton varieties tested under different distances from teak rows. -- https://www.thepharmajournal.com/archives/2022/vol11issue9/PartO/11-8-230-471.pdf
- Field-trial yield values for AKH-9916 in Maharashtra: No evidence found.

GENETICS AND QTL
- Combining ability: In a three-environment study, DHY 286, AKH 9916 and AKH 10-5 were the best general combiners for seed cotton yield and components. -- https://www.ijcmas.com/7-10-2018/H.B.%20Kumbhalkar,%20et%20al.pdf
- Heterosis: the cross AKH 8828 x AKH 9916 gave the highest standard heterosis for seed cotton yield per plant (60.30%) over PKV Hy-2 in a 2017-18 study at three Maharashtra locations. -- https://www.ijcmas.com/abstractview.php?ID=22295&vol=10-7-2021&SNo=11
- Genetic-analysis adequacy study lists AKH-9916 among genotypes, but no QTL or marker data were captured. -- https://www.academia.edu/Documents/in/Better_Cotton_Initiatives?before=83153727
- Parentage (KML-322 x KML-132, KML-09) and QTL/marker studies: No evidence found.

BREEDER AND INSTITUTION
- Institution: AKH-9916 is listed as a Dr. PDKV, Akola (Cotton Research Unit) variety. -- https://www.pdkv.

search_metadata.evidence_digest:
STRESS TOLERANCE
No evidence found for KMH-218 Plus (also searched as "KMH 218+"). The search returned no drought, heat, salinity, flood or submergence data for this hybrid. Agrostar lists it only as an irrigated crop, which is an agronomy note, not a stress rating. -- https://agrostar.in/product/kaveri-kmh-218-yellow-maize-4-kg-seeds/AGS-S-617?language=en&state=gujarat

DISEASE AND PEST
No evidence found for KMH-218 Plus. The search returned disease and pest resistance claims for other maize hybrids only, which I have discarded. Searched under both names.

AGRONOMY AND TRIALS
- [name: KMH 218+ (Agrostar listing, same product name variant)] Type of Variety: Double cross, dry seed variety; cob colour yellow; irrigation requirement irrigated, with a listed crop duration of 85-90 days and dibbling at 45-60 cm by 15 cm spacing, for Kharif or Rabi sowing -- https://agrostar.in/product/kaveri-kmh-218-yellow-maize-4-kg-seeds/AGS-S-617?language=en&state=gujarat
- [name: KMH-218 Plus] An AICMIP list of hybrids released from 2000 gives a medium maturity class, UP/Bihar/Jharkhand/Orissa adaptation, and an average yield of about 6.3 t/ha (the table columns are misaligned, so the yield figure is inferred) -- https://aicmip.naarm.org.in/Documents/Hybrids%20of%20maize%20released-1.pdf
- [name: KMH-218 Plus] A ResearchGate compilation of Indian maize varieties lists it under Kaveri Seed Company, Hyderabad, for Kharif in the same four states. Its yield column is garbled, so no yield is attributed to it there -- https://www.researchgate.net/publication/290428916_benchmarking_indian_maize_varieties
- Note: the Agrostar duration (85-90 days) and the AICMIP maturity class (medium) are not consistent with each other.

GENETICS AND QTL
No evidence found. Parentage "(KML 2257 x KML 2003) x KML-5163" was not confirmed by any search result. No QTL or marker study was returned for this hybrid.

BREEDER AND INSTITUTION
- [name: KMH-218 Plus] Developer: Kaveri Seed Company Ltd, Hyderabad (ResearchGate compilation) -- https://www.researchgate.net/publication/290428916_benchmarking_indian_maize_varieties
- Lead breeder or scientist name: No evidence found. The company chairman's profile (G.V. Bhaskar Rao) is company-level only and is not linked to this variety, so I have not attributed it -- https://resglostocks.substack.com/p/kaveri-seeds-sowing-high-dividends
- Station or breeding location: No evidence found for this variety.

CONTACT DETAILS (institute-level, company contacts, as found)
- Registered office: #1-7-36 to 42, Sardar Patel Road, Secunderabad 500003, Telangana. Ph 040-27721457; Fax +91-40-2781 1237; info@kaveriseeds.in; website www.kaveriseeds.in -- https://www.kaveriseeds.in/contact-us/
- Product enquiries: purnachandrarao.s@kaveriseeds.in (named on the same page; no role title given) -- https://www.kaveriseeds.in/contact-us/
- Alternate office address on a 2016 exchange filing: #513-B, 5th Floor, Minerva Complex, S.D. Road, Secunderabad 500003; Tel +91-40-2784 2398, 2784 2405 -- https://www.bseindia.com/bseplus/AnnualReport/532899/5328990316.pdf
- Third-party listing (unverified, not a Kaveri source): Secunderabad, +91 8044464782 / 4102 -- https://m.indiamart.com/kaveri-seed
- No individual breeder contact found. The Seednet portal and the CSC minutes were not returned by any search.

PUBLICATIONS
- Authors not stated (year not stated). Benchmarking Indian maize varieties. ResearchGate compilation -- https://www.researchgate.net/publication/290428916_benchmarking_indian_maize_varieties
- Authors not stated (year not stated). Hybrids of maize released from 2000. AICMIP, NAARM report -- https://aicmip.naarm.org.in/Documents/Hybrids%20of%20maize%20released-1.pdf
- No peer-reviewed paper, thesis (KrishiKosh) or AICRP report specific to KMH-218 Plus was found.

SEED AVAILABILITY
- [name: KMH 218+] Agrostar lists a 4 kg pack at ₹900 (listed as down from ₹1050) -- https://agrostar.in/product/kaveri-kmh-218-yellow-maize-4-kg-seeds/AGS-S-617?language=en&state=gujarat
- No NSC, State Seed Corporation, KVK or SAU listing was found. Other Kaveri maize products (KMH 8322, 8333, 25K45) appeared in searches but are different varieties and were excluded.

RECOMMENDED STATES
- [name: KMH-218 Plus] Recommended for Uttar Pradesh, Bihar, Jharkhand and Odisha (Kharif). The search results do not restrict this to eastern UP, so "Eastern" in the input is not confirmed -- https://www.researchgate.net/publication/290428916_benchmarking_indian_maize_varieties
- Same states, listed as "Orissa" in the 2012 release table -- https://aicmip.naarm.org.in/Documents/Hybrids%20of%20maize%20released-1.pdf
- Notification: Bihar's list of notified varieties gives KMH-218 Plus a date of 10/09/2012, under S.O. 2125(E). This is the only release-date evidence found, and the year_of_release "NaT" field can be filled with 2012 on this basis -- https://dbtagriculture.bihar.gov.in/licence/Document/Variety.pdf

NAME CHECK
Both variety_name and seednet_variety_name are "KMH-218 Plus". The Seednet portal (seednet.gov.in) was not returned by any search, and the CSC release minutes were not found. The Agrostar "KMH 218+" listing is treated as the same product on name similarity alone and should be confirmed.

search_metadata.evidence_digest:
EVIDENCE DIGEST: KMH-25K60 (Maize)

Name note: The CSC release name and the Seednet name are both "KMH-25K60", so one name variant was used. I did not run a separate Seednet portal search, so no Seednet record was checked directly.

STRESS TOLERANCE
No evidence found for drought, heat, salinity, flood or submergence tolerance specific to KMH-25K60. The closest result is a general Kaveri statement that its hybrids are bred for resistance to pests, diseases, drought and heat, without naming this hybrid -- https://www.kaveriseeds.in/our-story/details-of-business/

DISEASE AND PEST
No evidence found for KMH-25K60 disease or pest resistance. The benchmarking presentation lists resistance traits for KMH-25K45 (Bumper), not KMH-25K60, so it was discarded for this heading -- https://www.researchgate.net/publication/290428916_benchmarking_indian_maize_varieties

AGRONOMY AND TRIALS
- Medium maturity class, with 86-95 days in kharif in plains and 115-130 days in rabi, is listed for KMH-25K60 -- https://www.researchgate.net/publication/290428916_benchmarking_indian_maize_varieties
- Listed as a medium-duration maize hybrid (90-100 days) in an Andhra Pradesh package of practices -- https://www.rarstpt.org/files/rars/package%20of%20practices/MaizePackage.pdf
- Yield is recorded as 8.3 t/ha in the IIMR and AICRPM cultivar lists, with kharif season and "Normal" (not specified further) for the cultivar type -- https://iimr.icar.gov.in/cultivars-2/ ; https://aicrpmaize.icar.gov.in/cultivars/
- Yield is recorded as 8.6 t/ha, with medium maturity and yellow dent grain, in the AICMIP list of hybrids released from 2000. This conflicts with the 8.3 t/ha figure above -- https://aicmip.naarm.org.in/Documents/Hybrids%20of%20maize%20released-1.pdf
- Kaveri's own 2010 update says the hybrid was identified by the Varietal Identification Committee for eventual notification after national-level performance -- http://value-picks.blogspot.com/2010/11/kaveri-seed-company-update.html (third-party stock blog reproducing company statement; treat as secondary)
- The MD interview says ICAR identified KMH 25K60 in National Evaluation trials -- http://value-picks.blogspot.com/2012/12/kaveri-seed-company-latest-interview.html (secondary source)

GENETICS AND QTL (genes, parentage, breeding-line codes, breeding method, genome resources)
- Parentage (KML-2254 x KML-2168): No evidence found in any search result. The parentage came from the input record only.
- Breeding-line codes, QTL, markers, genome resources: No evidence found for KMH-25K60. The ICAR 2011-12 crop improvement report notes that hybridity of other maize hybrids was confirmed using markers, but does not name this variety -- https://icar.org.in/sites/default/files/inline-files/crop-improvement-AR-2011-12.pdf
- The ICAR 2011-12 report lists KMH 25K60 among proprietary hybrids released (not a public-sector breeding product) -- https://icar.org.in/sites/default/files/inline-files/crop-improvement-AR-2011-12.pdf

BREEDER AND INSTITUTION
- Developing institution: Kaveri Seed Company Ltd., Hyderabad (private sector). Listed as the variety owner in the AICRPM cultivar list and the IIMR cultivar list -- https://aicrpmaize.icar.gov.in/cultivars/ ; https://iimr.icar.gov.in/cultivars-2/
- Lead breeder or scientist name: No evidence found. The Kaveri corporate pages name the company founder only, and no breeder is named for this hybrid -- https://www.kaveriseeds.in/media/corporate-profile/
- Kaveri describes its R&D as in-house and recognised by DSIR from 2001 -- https://www.kaveriseeds.in/our-story/details-of-business/
- Station or research centre: No evidence found.

CONTACT DETAILS
- No breeder contact found.
- Institution address from the input record (not verified by search): Kaveri Seed Company Limited, 513 B, V-Floor, Minerva Complex, S.D. Road, Secunderabad - 500 003.
- Institute-level web page: https://www.kaveriseeds.in/ (company site). No official email or phone was found in any result, so none is recorded.

PUBLICATIONS
- Kaul, J.; Kumar, B.; Karjagi, C.; Yadav, O. P. (2015). Benchmarking Indian maize varieties. Conference paper, special meeting on benchmarking agricultural and horticultural crops in India, IIWBR Karnal -- https://www.researchgate.net/publication/290428916_benchmarking_indian_maize_varieties (lists KMH-25K60 in the released-hybrids table; full text not accessed)
- ICAR-AICRPM. Hybrids of maize released from 2000 (release table). Report/list -- https://aicmip.naarm.org.in/Documents/Hybrids%20of%20maize%20released-1.pdf
- ICAR (2012). Crop Improvement, Annual Report 2011-12. ICAR annual report -- https://icar.org.in/sites/default/files/inline-files/crop-improvement-AR-2011-12.pdf
- No peer-reviewed paper, thesis (KrishiKosh) or DOI specific to KMH-25K60 was found.

SEED AVAILABILITY
- Kaveri lists KMH-25K60 in its maize portfolio on its corporate pages, which is company-level and not a dealer or stock listing -- https://www.kaveriseeds.in/our-story/details-of-business/
- No NSC, State Seed Corporation, KVK, SAU or dealer listing for KMH-25K60 was found. The Kaveri Bumper (KMH-25K45) and KMH 8333 listings found are other varieties and were discarded -- https://www.indiamart.com/proddetail/kaveri-bumper-kmh-25k45-hybrid-seed-corn-27284225091.html ; https://www.desikheti.com/collections/kaveri-seeds-maize-seeds-buy-online

RECOMMENDED STATES
- Andhra Pradesh, Maharashtra, Karnataka and Tamil Nadu. Listed in the IIMR/AICRPM cultivar list and the AICMIP list -- https://aicrpmaize.icar.gov.in/cultivars/ ; https://aicmip.naarm.org.in/Documents/Hybrids%20of%20maize%20released-1.pdf
- Notification record: Bihar's notified-variety list gives year of release 2010 and notification 10/09/2012 under S.O. 2125(E). The IIMR list gives notification date 09-10-2012 -- https://dbtagriculture.bihar.gov.in/licence/Document/Variety.pdf ; https://iimr.icar.gov.in/cultivars-2/

Discarded as off-topic: HGK60 transgenic maize papers (PLOS ONE, PubMed, PMC), PH25K0/PH25K1/PH25KM patents, KJC5360 and X90H605 patents, the Nature US Corn Belt paper, the PMC kernel-moisture GWAS, and the silage and K/Zn studies. Each names a different maize line or is a general maize study.

drought.details: The original variety data states that Kohinoor castor 'PERFORMS WELL UNDER IRRIGATED AND RAINFED CONDITIONS', implying adaptation to varying moisture levels. However, detailed drought tolerance mechanisms or specific performance data for Kohinoor castor (NBCH-66) were not found in the search results. Information regarding 'Kohinoor' exhibiting drought tolerance in the search results consistently pertains to maize or fodder crops, where it is described as 'highly drought tolerant' (Result 8) or listed among 'drought tolerant varieties' of maize (Result 4, 23, 3). 'IGFRI-5450(Kohinoor)' (a forage/pulse variety) is also noted for its 'unique tolerance ability against stress environmental conditions not only drought' (Result 5, 13, 25).

heat.details: No specific heat tolerance information was found for Kohinoor castor (NBCH-66) in the search results. 'Kohinoor' maize is mentioned in agro-advisories related to strategies to 'escape terminal heat stress at the time of maturity' (Result 12) and its use as fodder for animals in high temperatures (Result 14, 17). This information pertains to maize/fodder and is not confirmed for castor.

salinity.details: No specific salinity tolerance information was found for Kohinoor castor (NBCH-66). 'Kohinoor' (a maize variety) is listed among 'salt tolerant crops' for 'YAAS affected saline lands' in one advisory (Result 21). Maize, in general, is noted as not coming up well in saline soils (Result 27). This information pertains to maize and is not confirmed for castor.

flood.details: No specific flood tolerance information was found for Kohinoor castor (NBCH-66). Information regarding 'Kohinoor' and flood/waterlogging pertains to maize or forage crops. 'Kohinoor' maize has been associated with 'Lodging and water logging tolerant' traits in some releases (Result 31) and breeders are working on 'water logging tolerant' maize (Result 32). 'IGFRI-5450(Kohinoor)' (a forage variety) is noted in the context of being grown in 'flood prone areas where fields get flooded or waterlogged' (Result 39). Fodder maize, in general, is described as sensitive to waterlogging (Result 2, 33). This information pertains to maize/forage and is not confirmed for castor.

search_metadata.evidence_digest:
EVIDENCE DIGEST: MAH 14-5 (variety_name and seednet_variety_name are identical, so one set of evidence covers both; the seednet.gov.in portal was not returned by any search)

STRESS TOLERANCE
No evidence found. The four searches returned no page that describes drought, heat, salinity, flood, or submergence tolerance for MAH 14-5. -- https://uasbangalore.edu.in/wp-content/uploads/2026/08/English-varieties.pdf (only the MAH-20-45 entry mentions leaf rust and leaf spot resistance, and that is a different hybrid)

DISEASE AND PEST
AICRP Kharif Maize 2016 progress report lists MAH-14-5 in a zone-wise table with the entries MLB, TLB, CLS, C.RUST and RDM. The column headings are not legible in the extract, so the disease code meanings are unconfirmed. -- https://aicmip.naarm.org.in/AnnualReports/Maize%20AICRP%20REPORT%20KHARIF%202016.pdf
The table row does not state a resistance rating, so this is a pathology trial listing, not a resistance result. No other disease or pest finding for MAH 14-5 was found.

AGRONOMY AND TRIALS
UAS Bangalore Zone-5 release notice (2025-26): maize hybrid MAH-20-45 averaged 110.6 q/ha, which is 14.6% above the check hybrid MAH-14-5 at 96.6 q/ha. This is the only yield figure found for MAH 14-5, and it is as a check in another hybrid's trial. -- https://www.uasbangalore.edu.in/wp-content/uploads/2026/08/English-varieties.pdf
No maturity, plant height, or yield data specific to MAH 14-5 was found.

GENETICS AND QTL
No evidence found. No parentage, pedigree, marker, or QTL information was found for MAH 14-5. The parentage field reads "Not specified."

BREEDER AND INSTITUTION
No evidence found. No page names a lead breeder or developing scientist for MAH 14-5. The release metadata lists "University of Agricultural Sciences" as the institution, and the search results did not confirm which UAS it is.
Not attributed to this variety: the AICRP 2016 report names a maize breeder at Parbhani (Dr V.R. Naik, Marathwada Krishi Vidyapeeth) on the same page as the MAH-14-5 table, but the page does not link him to MAH 14-5, so he is not recorded as its breeder. -- https://aicmip.naarm.org.in/AnnualReports/Maize%20AICRP%20REPORT%20KHARIF%202016.pdf

CONTACT DETAILS
No evidence found. No breeder, institute email, phone, or postal address for MAH 14-5 was retrieved. The UAS Bangalore pages retrieved carry no contact details, and the UAS Bangalore agri-innovation maize page (https://uasbagriinnovationcenter.in/maize/) lists MAH-14-5 without contact information.

PUBLICATIONS
No evidence found. No journal article, thesis, conference paper, or AICRP report section focused on MAH 14-5 was retrieved. The AICRP 2016 report above is the only official document that names the variety, and it is a table entry rather than a study.

SEED AVAILABILITY
No evidence found. The seed search returned only a Syngenta listing for "Hybrid Maize Seed Mah 15 84" (a different hybrid, discarded) and unrelated international pages. No NSC, state seed corporation, KVK, SAU seed-sales, or dealer listing for MAH 14-5 was found. -- https://www.indiamart.com/syngenta-121616571/maize-seeds.html (discarded: different product)

RECOMMENDED STATES
Release metadata gives Karnataka as the recommended state. No search result confirms this. The UAS Bangalore Zone-5 notice names MAH-14-5 only as a check, not as a recommended hybrid, so it does not confirm the recommendation. -- https://www.uasbangalore.edu.in/wp-content/uploads/2026/08/English-varieties.pdf
Other listing: the UAS Bangalore agri-innovation maize page includes MAH-14-5 among its maize entries, but it does not state a recommendation status. -- https://uasbagriinnovationcenter.in/maize/

search_metadata.evidence_digest:
EVIDENCE DIGEST: Mizo Popcorn 1 (MZM 17), maize

Search note: The web_search tool limit was reached after four searches, so the digest is limited to what those four searches returned. Headings with "No evidence found" were searched but returned no usable content. The variety_name "Mizo Popcorn 1" and seednet_variety_name "Mizo Popcorn 1 (MZM 17)" both appear in the evidence, and the bulletin below uses the code "MZM-17" with the name "Mizo popcorn-1".

STRESS TOLERANCE -- No evidence found (searched; no stress-tolerance data for MZM-17 in results).

DISEASE AND PEST -- No evidence found (searched; no disease or pest resistance data for MZM-17 in results).

AGRONOMY AND TRIALS -- The only related source describes Mizoram popcorn (Puakzo) as a multi-cob landrace with cob-bearing and seeding-stage characteristics, and it is about a sister landrace (MZM-31, IC-611490), not MZM-17 -- https://www.researchgate.net/publication/304803359_Multi_cob-bearing_popcorn_Puakzo_maize_A_unique_landrace_of_Mizoram_North_East_India. No yield, maturity, or trial figures for MZM-17 were found.

GENETICS AND QTL -- No evidence found (searched; no QTL, marker, or genetic-parentage data; parentage is "Not specified" in the record).

BREEDER AND INSTITUTION -- A 2025 technical bulletin lists "Mizo popcorn-1 (MZM-17): A multi cob bearing popcorn variety of Mizoram" in its list of Mizoram varieties, but it does not name the breeder or the developing station in the retrieved text -- https://www.researchgate.net/publication/396231624_2025_Technical_Bull_Golden_Technology. Institution per the record: ICAR Regional Centre for NEH Region. Lead breeder name: not found.

CONTACT DETAILS -- No breeder, institute, or division contact (name, email, phone, or address) was found in the retrieved results. Unverified: the institute's official website should be checked directly for a contact page, since I could not confirm one through search.

salinity.details: No direct evidence of salinity tolerance. The NAAC document reports tolerance to alkaline soil, which is a distinct property from salinity and is not a salinity test result. The only saline-alkali reference (pH above 8) describes a trial farm and not a tolerance test.

flood.details: No direct evidence of flood tolerance was found in the digest.

disease_resistance.summary: No disease resistance is documented for NDB White-1. No evidence was found for resistance to bacterial wilt, little leaf, phomopsis, or other diseases. pest_resistance.summary: Listed as resistant to brinjal fruit and shoot borer (Leucinodes orbonalis) in the NAAC document. No screening data are given, so the strength of this resistance is unverified.

agronomic_details.adaptation: Recommended for Zone-III (Barapani, Port Blair, Nagaland) and Zone IV (Punjab, UP, Bihar, Jharkhand) per NDUAT documents. Starts bearing in the 4th year. Early ripening (November), listed as the earliest among released varieties.
agronomic_details.plant_characteristics: Fruit weight 52.76 g; fruit size 4.18 x 4.41 cm; 6 seeds per fruit; TSS 11.5 degrees Brix. Fruit shape conflicts between sources: flattened round in one NDUAT document and medium long in the 2021 NDUAT list.
agronomic_details.field_trials: (1) AICRP (VC) trials, coded 2017/BRLVAR-7: average yield 380 q/ha, potential yield 548 q/ha; identified at the 39th AICRP (VC) Group Meeting, IIVR Varanasi. (2) Recommended at the 39th AICRP (VC) Group Meeting, September 7-9, 2021 (2021 NDUAT list). (3) Used as parental line P5 in a 10-parent diallel (45 crosses) grown at the Kumarganj main experiment station in 2020-21 and 2021-22; this study evaluated genetic variability and genetic advance rather than variety performance. Name-specific trial records beyond the AICRP recommendation were not found.

search_metadata.evidence_digest:
STRESS TOLERANCE
Tolerant to alkaline soil and shady conditions; suited to ratoon cropping (evidence refers to "Narendra Suyog (NDB White-1)", the variety_name) -- https://www.nduat.org/Doc/NAAC/3.4.3.1.pdf
Described as drought tolerant in a 2021 NDUAT list, but that entry is for a different brinjal line in a subtropical-arid context, so it does not apply to NDB White-1 -- https://www.nduat.org/Doc/Varieties_Technologies_2021.pdf
No direct evidence of salinity, flood, submergence, or heat tolerance for this variety. The only saline-alkali reference (pH above 8) describes a trial farm, not a tolerance test -- https://www.envirobiotechjournals.com/EEC//EEC-65_2.pdf

DISEASE AND PEST
Listed as resistant to brinjal fruit and shoot borer (Leucinodes orbonalis); no screening data given -- https://www.nduat.org/Doc/NAAC/3.4.3.1.pdf
No evidence found for resistance to bacterial wilt, little leaf, phomopsis, or other diseases.

AGRONOMY AND TRIALS
Season: kharif and rabi; fertilizer NPK 100:50:50 kg/ha plus 250 q FYM/ha; starts bearing in the 4th year; early ripening (November), listed as the earliest among released varieties -- https://www.nduat.org/Doc/NAAC/3.4.3.1.pdf
Average yield 380 q/ha, potential yield 548 q/ha, coded 2017/BRLVAR-7 in AICRP (VC) trials, identified at the 39th AICRP (VC) Group Meeting, IIVR Varanasi -- https://www.nduat.org/Doc/NAAC/3.4.3.1.pdf
Average yield 34.73 kg/plant; fruit weight 52.76 g; fruit 4.18 x 4.41 cm; 6 seeds per fruit; TSS 11.5 degrees Brix -- https://www.nduat.org/Doc/NAAC/3.4.3.1.pdf
Fruit shape conflict: flattened round in one NDUAT document, medium long in another (2021 list) -- https://www.nduat.org/Doc/NAAC/3.4.3.1.pdf ; https://www.nduat.org/Doc/Varieties_Technologies_2021.pdf
Release/identification: no CSC notification year found. The 2021 NDUAT list records it as recommended at the 39th AICRP (VC) Group Meeting, September 7-9, 2021 -- https://www.nduat.org/Doc/Varieties_Technologies_2021.pdf
Name-specific trial records were not found beyond the AICRP recommendation.

GENETICS AND QTL
NDB White-1 was used as parental line P5 in a 10-parent diallel (45 crosses) grown at the Kumarganj main experiment station in 2020-21 and 2021-22 -- https://www.envirobiotechjournals.com/EEC//EEC-65_2.pdf
No QTL, marker, or molecular studies found for NDB White-1.

BREEDER AND INSTITUTION
Developing institution: Acharya Narendra Deva University of Agriculture and Technology (ANDUAT), Narendra Nagar (Kumarganj), Ayodhya, UP. Developed/maintained by the Department of Vegetable Science, College of Horticulture and Forestry; the department was set up in 1980 and was an AICRP (Vegetable crops) sub-centre -- https://www.nduat.org/pdf/Department%20of%20Vegetable%20Science.pdf
Lead breeder name: not found in any source. Department faculty named in related papers include Aastik Jha (Associate Professor, Vegetable Science) and Vipin Kumar Maurya with G.C. Yadav (co-author of the NDB White-1 diallel study) -- https://www.biochemjournal.com/archives/2025/vol9issue7/PartG/9-7-78-526.pdf ; https://www.envirobiotechjournals.com/EEC//EEC-65_2.pdf
Note: these faculty are associated with the Department of Vegetable Science. No source confirms them as breeders of NDB White-1.

CONTACT DETAILS
No breeder email or phone found.
Institute postal address as printed in ANDUAT papers: Acharya Narendra Deva University of Agriculture & Technology, Kumarganj, Ayodhya 224 229, Uttar Pradesh, India -- https://www.nduat.org/pdf/Department%20of%20Vegetable%20Science.pdf
Department: Vegetable Science, College of Horticulture and Forestry (Narendra Nagar, Kumarganj, Ayodhya, UP). Official phone/email not found in the retrieved pages.
Institute website: https://www.nduat.org (no contact page URL was retrieved; search the site's contact page for official details).
Aastik Jha (Associate Professor, Department of Vegetable Science, College of Horticulture & Forestry) listed as corresponding author; no email given in retrieved text -- https://www.biochemjournal.com/archives/2025/vol9issue7/PartG/9-7-78-526.pdf

PUBLICATIONS
Maurya, V.K. and Yadav, G.C. (year not shown in retrieved text). Diallel analysis of ten brinjal parents including NDB White-1; genetic variability and genetic advance in 45 crosses, 2020-21 and 2021-22. Journal not clearly identified in retrieved text (Environment and Ecology-type PDF). -- https://www.envirobiotechjournals.com/EEC//EEC-65_2.pdf
Varieties and Technologies 2021, NDUAT. Narendra Suyog (NDB White-1) recommended at 39th AICRP (VC) Group Meeting, 2021. NDUAT institutional document -- https://www.nduat.org/Doc/Varieties_Technologies_2021.pdf
NAAC criterion 3.4.3.1 variety description, NDUAT. Narendra Suyog (NDB White-1) description and trial yields. Institutional document -- https://www.nduat.org/Doc/NAAC/3.4.3.1.pdf
No KrishiKosh thesis, AICRP annual report chapter, or peer-reviewed paper devoted specifically to NDB White-1 was found in the searches.

SEED AVAILABILITY
No seed record found for NDB White-1 / Narendra Suyog from NSC, a state seed corporation, KVK, ANDUAT seed sales, or private dealers.
Seednet record "NLD WHITE" (variety in a Bihar notified-variety list) appears with notification date 14/05/1986 and S.O. 258(E). This is not the same entity as the 2021 brinjal recommendation and is not confirmed to be the brinjal line -- https://dbtagriculture.bihar.gov.in/licence/Document/Variety.pdf

RECOMMENDED STATES
Zone-III (Barapani, Port Blair, Nagaland) and Zone IV (Punjab, UP, Bihar, Jharkhand) -- https://www.nduat.org/Doc/NAAC/3.4.3.1.pdf ; https://www.nduat.org/Doc/Varieties_Technologies_2021.pdf
Consistent with the supplied list (A&N, North East, Bihar, Jharkhand, Punjab, UP). Note that the 2021 NDUAT list gives the zone assignment without naming states individually.

NAME AND RECORD CONFLICTS (for reviewer)
- variety_name "NDB White-1" = "Narendra Suyog (NDB White-1)" in NDUAT and AICRP documents; these are the evidence sources for this record.
- seednet_variety_name "NLD WHITE" is under MAIZE (MAKKA) on Seednet, with a 1986 Bihar notification; no evidence links it to brinjal. Its crop and code cannot be reconciled with the brinjal entry from the sources found. Verify on seednet.gov.in before using this seednet record.
- year_of_release "NaT" should be replaced with 2021 (AICRP identification), but a CSC notification year is still unconfirmed.
- Parentage "not known" is consistent with the search results; NDB White-1 appears as a parent line in a diallel but its own pedigree was not found.

search_metadata.evidence_digest:
NMH-51 maize: evidence digest

Variety name (CSC minutes): NMH-51. Seednet name: NMH-51. Both names are identical, so one set of searches covers both. Four searches were run. None returned a record for NMH-51 itself, so most headings below are "No evidence found."

STRESS TOLERANCE -- No evidence found. Searches on the variety name returned no stress-tolerance data for NMH-51.

DISEASE AND PEST -- No evidence found. No disease or pest resistance data for NMH-51 appeared in the results.

AGRONOMY AND TRIALS -- No evidence found. No NMH-51 trial, yield, maturity, or agronomy records appeared. The only NMH-numbered trial results were for other hybrids, such as NMH-731 in a Nepal nitrogen trial (https://www.nepjol.info/index.php/janr/article/download/33656/26460/98577), which does not concern NMH-51.

GENETICS AND QTL -- No evidence found. No parentage or QTL/marker data for NMH-51 appeared. The "parentage: Not specified" field in the input was not resolved.

BREEDER AND INSTITUTION -- No evidence found. No breeder name, developing station, or institution page for NMH-51 appeared. The input lists Nirmal Seeds Pvt. Ltd. as the institution, but no search result confirmed this.

CONTACT DETAILS -- No evidence found. No breeder, institute, or company contact for NMH-51 or Nirmal Seeds Pvt. Ltd. appeared in any search.

PUBLICATIONS -- No evidence found. No paper, AICRP/ICAR report, thesis, or KrishiKosh record for NMH-51 appeared.

SEED AVAILABILITY -- No evidence found. No NSC, state seed corporation, KVK, SAU, or dealer listing for NMH-51 appeared. A Nuziveedu product page lists a different NMH-named hybrid, "Bond NMH-007," so it does not refer to NMH-51 (https://nuziveeduseeds.com/products/field-crop/maize-variety/).

RECOMMENDED STATES -- Input record only: Assam (CSC/input data, not verified by search). The AICMIP list of released maize hybrids (https://aicmip.naarm.org.in/Documents/Hybrids%20of%20maize%20released-1.pdf) includes several NMH-series entries, such as NMH-731 (2012, late maturity) and NMH-803 and NMH-920 (2012). NMH-51 does not appear in the extract I saw. That extract is partial, so I cannot confirm its absence from the full list. The release year of 2022-10-26 in the input also could not be checked.

Notes for the record:
- The only NMH-series references in the results are to other hybrids, so none of them should be attributed to NMH-51.
- To close the gaps, check the CSC/AICMIP notification for NMH-51 directly, the Seednet portal entry, and Nirmal Seeds' own product literature.

search_metadata.evidence_digest:
EVIDENCE DIGEST: NMH-803 (maize)

Name note: variety_name and seednet_variety_name are both "NMH-803", so one name covers both. The searches did not return a Seednet portal page, so no Seednet-specific evidence is reported. Pages also use the trade name "Shaurya NMH-803", which I treat as the same variety because it carries the NMH-803 designation.

STRESS TOLERANCE
- Nuziveedu's own social-media listing for "Shaurya NMH-803" describes it as drought tolerant, with medium plant height and medium maturity (company marketing claim, not independent trial data) -- https://in.pinterest.com/nuziveeduseeds/hybrid-corn-seeds/
- No evidence found for heat, salinity, flood or submergence tolerance in the retrieved pages.

DISEASE AND PEST
- No evidence found. The searches returned no disease or pest resistance data for NMH-803.

AGRONOMY AND TRIALS
- The AICMIP list of released maize hybrids gives NMH-803 as a medium-duration yellow dent hybrid with a yield of 6.2 t/ha -- https://aicmip.naarm.org.in/Documents/Hybrids%20of%20maize%20released-1.pdf
- A benchmarking presentation based on AICRP (maize) testing lists NMH-803 (Nuziveedu Seeds) among hybrids notified in 2013, with 6.2 t/ha and orange-yellow, semi-dent grain -- https://www.researchgate.net/publication/290428916_benchmarking_indian_maize_varieties
- An Assam state (Dept. of Agriculture) report on RKVY 2016-17 records a farm-level yield of 68.75 q/ha under NMH-803 seed in Assam, a non-recommended state, so it is field-level and not a multi-location trial -- https://diragri.assam.gov.in/sites/default/files/swf_utility_folder/departments/diragri_medhassu_in_oid_4/portlet/level_1/files/Additional%20income%20through%20Maize%20cultivation_0.pdf

GENETICS AND QTL
- No evidence found for QTL, marker or genomic studies of NMH-803. The parentage "(NM-124 x NM-250) x NM-161" comes only from the input record and was not verified by any retrieved source.

BREEDER AND INSTITUTION
- The release-table and benchmarking sources credit the variety to Nuziveedu Seeds Pvt. Ltd. (no lead breeder or scientist named) -- https://www.researchgate.net/publication/290428916_benchmarking_indian_maize_varieties
- A company profile lists "Shaurya NMH 803" among Nuziveedu maize products (no breeder named) -- https://theorg.com/org/nuziveedu-seeds-ltd
- No evidence found for a named lead breeder, developing station or ICAR/SAU institute.

CONTACT DETAILS
- No evidence found for a breeder email, phone or postal address. No institute contact page for NMH-803 was retrieved. Institution-level contacts were not searched, so none are reported.

PUBLICATIONS
- Authors not stated in retrieved text (n.d.). Benchmarking Indian maize varieties. AICRP (maize) conference presentation -- https://www.researchgate.net/publication/290428916_benchmarking_indian_maize_varieties
- No peer-reviewed papers, KrishiKosh theses or AICRP annual-report entries specific to NMH-803 were retrieved.

SEED AVAILABILITY
- A Assam state RKVY 2016-17 scheme distributed NMH-803 hybrid seed through agriculture officers -- https://diragri.assam.gov.in/sites/default/files/swf_utility_folder/departments/diragri_medhassu_in_oid_4/portlet/level_1/files/Additional%20income%20through%20Maize%20cultivation_0.pdf
- No evidence found for NSC, State Seed Corporation, KVK, SAU or current dealer listings. A BigHaat result for "Divya NMH3" (NEO Seeds, out of stock) is a different product and was discarded.

RECOMMENDED STATES
- Release-table entry: Eastern Uttar Pradesh, Bihar, Jharkhand, Orissa, Rajasthan, Gujarat, Madhya Pradesh and Chhattisgarh -- https://aicmip.naarm.org.in/Documents/Hybrids%20of%20maize%20released-1.pdf
- The benchmarking presentation gives a similar list (Uttar Pradesh, Bihar, Jharkhand, Odisha, Rajasthan, Gujarat, Madhya Pradesh, Chhattisgarh, kharif) -- https://www.researchgate.net/publication/290428916_benchmarking_indian_maize_varieties

RELEASE YEAR CONFLICT
- year_of_release is missing ("NaT") in the input. The AICMIP table gives 2012, while the benchmarking presentation says the hybrid was notified in 2013. The CSC minutes were not retrieved, so the official year is unconfirmed.

EVIDENCE DIGEST: NMH 4140 (maize)

Name check: the variety_name and seednet_variety_name are both "NMH 4140", so the searches covered one name. None of the four searches returned a page that mentions NMH 4140 specifically. Findings below are either company-level or about other hybrids, and are labelled that way.

STRESS TOLERANCE:
No evidence found for NMH 4140. The only related material is a generic company statement that Nuziveedu's maize seed is bred using advanced technologies to enhance resistance against diseases, pests, and environmental stressors -- https://nuziveeduseeds.com/products/field-crop/maize-variety/ (company-level claim, not NMH 4140 data)
Drought tolerance is listed for a different hybrid, NMH-007 Bond, which is Tolerance to draught -- https://nuziveeduseeds.com/products/field-crop/maize-variety/ (not NMH 4140)

DISEASE AND PEST:
No evidence found for NMH 4140. Company-level only: the company's breeding programme includes the fall army worm in maize -- https://www.accesstoseeds.org/index/south-southeast-asia/company-scorecards/nuziveedu-seeds/
Bond NMH-007 is listed with Moderate disease tolerance -- https://nuziveeduseeds.com/products/field-crop/maize-variety/ (not NMH 4140)

AGRONOMY AND TRIALS:
No evidence found for NMH 4140 (no maturity, yield, or multi-location trial data located).
Other hybrid, for comparison only: NMH-007 Bond is listed with Duration: 105-110 days -- https://nuziveeduseeds.com/products/field-crop/maize-variety/ (not NMH 4140)

GENETICS AND QTL:
No evidence found. The parentage (NM-1061 x NM-318) was supplied in the input and was not verified by any search result.

BREEDER AND INSTITUTION:

- Caution: the drought tolerance listed on the company's maize catalogue page belongs to a different product, Bond NMH-007, not NMH 4144. -- https://nuziveeduseeds.com/products/field-crop/maize-variety/

DISEASE AND PEST
- The company lists NMH 4144 (as "Kranthi NMH-4144") with Tolerance to leaf blight and downy mildew. This is a company claim with no independent trial data. -- https://nuziveeduseeds.com/products/field-crop/
- Insect resistance: No evidence found.

AGRONOMY AND TRIALS
- The company gives Kharif duration as 105-110 days and Rabi as 115-120 days, and describes Attractive orange and heavy grain. -- https://nuziveeduseeds.com/products/field-crop/
- Yield data, multi-location trial results and AICRP/ICAR test results for NMH 4144: No evidence found. The AICRP papers returned by query 3 (for example the NIVT-Late 2020–21 study) test other entries. -- https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC13385124/

GENETICS AND QTL

BREEDER AND INSTITUTION
- Developer: NMH-4144 Kranthi Hybrid Maize Product Launch Cake Cutting by Nuziveedu Seeds Team. This is a LinkedIn post, not an official record. -- https://www.linkedin.com/in/niharika-chowdari/

CONTACT DETAILS

One Nuziveedu retail page lists a different product, "Mishthi" hybrid sweet corn, with 75-80 day maturity and high yield claims. It is not named NUZI 260, so it is discarded under the strict relevance rule. -- https://krushidukan.bharatagri.com/en/products/nuziveedu-mishthi-hybrid-sweet-corn-seeds (not used: different product name)

GENETICS AND QTL -- No evidence found. Parentage (NSCL-91 x NSCL-202, with the listed pedigrees) was not confirmed by any search result. The genetics pages returned concern sweet corn in general, such as South China Agricultural University GWAS and BIOTEC Thailand sweetness GWAS, and do not name this variety. -- https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC13468538/ and https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/pmc/articles/PMC8235792/ (not used: other germplasm)

BREEDER AND INSTITUTION -- No evidence found for a lead breeder or scientist of NUZI 260. The institution listed in the record is Nuziveedu Seeds Ltd. Company-level sources describe it as a private agribusiness, headquartered in Hyderabad, that develops and markets maize and sweet corn hybrids. These do not confirm that the company developed NUZI 260. -- https://nuziveeduseeds.com/products/ ; https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nuziveedu_Seeds

CONTACT DETAILS -- No breeder contact found. No official email, phone, or postal address for NUZI 260 or its breeding division was returned. The only company-level information is a headquarters in Hyderabad, India, and the website nuziveeduseeds.com. This is institute-level only and is not verified for this variety. -- https://www.accesstoseeds.org/index/south-southeast-asia/company-scorecards/nuziveedu-seeds/ ; https://nuziveeduseeds.com/products/

PUBLICATIONS -- No evidence found. None of the searches (including KrishiKosh-style and journal-style queries) returned a paper, AICRP or ICAR report, thesis, or trial report naming NUZI 260. Returned papers were on sweet corn in other countries and were discarded.

SEED AVAILABILITY -- No evidence found for NUZI 260. Nuziveedu-branded sweet corn appears on several retail sites under the name "Misthi" (for example, desikheti.com and beejkart.com). That name is not NUZI 260, so it is discarded. No NSC, state seed corporation, KVK, SAU, or official Seednet listing was returned. -- https://www.desikheti.com/collections/nuziveedu-seeds (discarded: different product name)

RECOMMENDED STATES -- No evidence found. The recommended-state list in the record (Punjab through Telangana) could not be checked against any source, and no Seednet or CSC notification page was returned for this variety.

NOTE ON NAMES -- Both the CSC name "NUZI 260 (Sweet Corn)" and the Seednet name "NUZI 260 (Sweet Corn)" are identical in this record. Searches under both names returned no evidence for either. Seednet, the CSC minutes, and ICAR sites were not reachable through search results, so an official check still needs to be done directly on seednet.gov.in.

search_metadata.evidence_digest:
EVIDENCE DIGEST: PAC 753 (maize)

Name searched: "PAC 753" (variety_name and seednet_variety_name are both "PAC 753"; no separate Seednet name was found, so this digest covers the same name under both headings).
Searches run: 4 (variety/release, breeder/institution, research papers, seed availability).
Result: none of the searches returned a page that names PAC 753 as a maize variety. The searches returned pages on PAC 751, PAC 741, PAC 740 and PAC 746, which are different varieties and were excluded under the strict relevance rule. Unrelated pages on paclobutrazol, maize genomics, and other maize hybrids were also excluded.

STRESS TOLERANCE: No evidence found. Search 1 returned only commercial pages for PAC 751 Elite (lodging and disease claims), which name a different variety and were excluded.

DISEASE AND PEST: No evidence found. The only disease-related text returned was for PAC 751 Elite and PAC 741, which are different varieties and were excluded.

AGRONOMY AND TRIALS: No evidence found. Search 1 and search 3 returned no PAC 753 yield, maturity, sowing, or multi-location trial data. Season and maturity text on retailer pages refers to PAC 751 and PAC 740, not PAC 753.

GENETICS AND QTL: No evidence found. Search 3 returned no QTL, marker, or parentage study for PAC 753. The parentage "753F x 753M" did not appear in any result.

BREEDER AND INSTITUTION: No evidence found. Search 2 returned no breeder name, developing scientist, or institute page for PAC 753. The only developer-related text was for PAC 751 Elite, which is a different variety.

CONTACT DETAILS: No evidence found. No UPL or Advanta institute contact page, email, phone, or address was found for PAC 753. Search 2 returned no contact details for PAC 753.

PUBLICATIONS: No evidence found. Search 3 returned no journal article, AICRP or ICAR report, KrishiKosh thesis, or conference paper on PAC 753. The results were on unrelated maize topics (paclobutrazol field trials, maize genome sequencing, and metal nanoparticles) and were excluded.

SEED AVAILABILITY: No evidence found for PAC 753. Search 4 returned retail listings (IndiaMART, BigHaat, DesiKheti) that sell PAC 751 and PAC 751 Elite, and a listing titled "PAC 751 Hybrid Corn" on BigHaat. These are a different variety and were excluded. No NSC, State Seed Corporation, KVK, SAU, or Seednet listing for PAC 753 was found.

RECOMMENDED STATES: No evidence found. The release year (2019-06-01) and "Madhya Pradesh" as the recommended state in the CSC record could not be verified from any search result. One PAC 751 Elite retail page mentions Madhya Pradesh, but it refers to a different variety and was excluded.

Recommended next steps: check the CSC or ICAR release notification for "PAC 753" directly, search the Seednet portal (seednet.gov.in) for variety code A0207701, and confirm with UPL Limited whether the name is spelled differently in its own product catalogue.

NOTE: The record conflicts. "Parbat" (variety_name, crop walnut) matches a walnut release, JWSP 06 (PARBAT). "PARBHAT" (seednet_variety_name, crop MAIZE (MAKKA)) and its parentage (Prabhat J-115, Partap J54 x Suwan 1) describe a maize variety. These are likely two different varieties, so the findings below are not merged. Only four searches ran; a later fifth search hit the tool limit. Most headings therefore have little or no evidence.

STRESS TOLERANCE
No evidence found for PARBHAT/Prabhat (maize) in the searches. No stress-tolerance data was found for the walnut Parbat either.

DISEASE AND PEST
No evidence found.

AGRONOMY AND TRIALS
Walnut Parbat (JWSP 06): the search returned only an abstract fragment, which says the variety was notified as an elite walnut selection by the Government of Jammu and Kashmir. No yield or trial data was retrieved. -- https://www.researchgate.net/publication/353156900_Walnut_Variety_Release_JWSP_06_PARBAT
Maize PARBHAT/Prabhat: No evidence found. The only related hit was a general article on maize production trends in Jammu & Kashmir, with no variety data. -- https://www.researchgate.net/publication/357280433_Trends_of_maize_production_in_Jammu_Kashmir

GENETICS AND QTL
Maize PARBHAT/Prabhat: the parentage field (Partap J54 x Suwan 1, backcross with Partap, then mass selection) is from the input record only. No independent source was retrieved to confirm it. No QTL or marker study was found.

BREEDER AND INSTITUTION
Walnut Parbat: the notifying body is the Government of Jammu and Kashmir. The breeder name and developing institution were not found in the retrieved text.
Maize PARBHAT/Prabhat: the input record names Sher-e-Kashmir University of Agricultural Sciences and Technology (SKUAST) as institution. No independent confirmation was found. The search for a breeder returned only an unrelated maize hybrid (Karimnagar Makka-1). -- https://www.researchgate.net/publication/359278789_Maize_Hybrid_Karimnagar_Makka-1

CONTACT DETAILS
No breeder contact was found under either name. No SKUAST or institute email, phone, address or contact-page URL was retrieved.

PUBLICATIONS
Walnut Parbat: the only item is a ResearchGate record titled "Walnut Variety Release JWSP 06 (PARBAT)". Authors, year and journal were not visible in the retrieved text. -- https://www.researchgate.net/publication/353156900_Walnut_Variety_Release_JWSP_06_PARBAT
Maize PARBHAT/Prabhat: a search for "Prabhat J-115" returned a general maize paper (benchmarking Indian maize varieties) with no visible reference to Prabhat. Not counted as a publication for this variety. -- https://www.researchgate.net/publication/290428916_benchmarking_indian_maize_varieties

SEED AVAILABILITY
No evidence found for NSC, State Seed Corporation, KVK, SKUAST seed sales or private dealers under either name.

RECOMMENDED STATES
Input record (maize PARBHAT, seednet): Jammu and Kashmir. Not independently confirmed.
Walnut Parbat: notified by the Government of Jammu and Kashmir (see AGRONOMY AND TRIALS). No state-level recommendation text was retrieved.

YEAR OF RELEASE
Input record shows NaT (missing). No release year was found for either name.

drought.details: No specific information regarding HPC-4's drought tolerance was found in the provided search results. General maize research indicates that drought stress significantly reduces plant height, leaf area, biomass, and yield characteristics (RESULT_7, RESULT_37). Breeding for drought-tolerant maize genotypes is a practical approach to address water deficit (RESULT_5, RESULT_9). Several QTLs associated with drought tolerance have been identified and exploited in maize breeding programs (RESULT_10, RESULT_33). Molecular insights into drought tolerance mechanisms are being investigated (RESULT_2, RESULT_23, RESULT_24, RESULT_32).

heat.details: No specific information regarding HPC-4's heat tolerance was found in the provided search results. General maize research indicates that heat stress is a serious issue affecting plant growth, development, and productivity (RESULT_12). Heat stress, along with drought, is a main driver of maize yield losses (RESULT_11). Increasing heat stress and rising temperatures are key abiotic stresses impacting agriculture (RESULT_13, RESULT_18).

salinity.details: No specific information regarding HPC-4's salinity tolerance was found in the provided search results. General maize research indicates that salinity stress negatively impacts maize growth (RESULT_8, RESULT_14, RESULT_22, RESULT_36). Methods like sorghum water extract (SWE) and neem and castor oil-coated urea are being studied for mitigating salinity effects in maize (RESULT_8, RESULT_14, RESULT_22, RESULT_25, RESULT_36). Salinity is identified as a significant abiotic stress causing crop yield losses (RESULT_13).

flood.details: No specific information regarding HPC-4's flood tolerance was found in the provided search results. Waterlogging is identified as an abiotic stress impacting crop yield (RESULT_13). Studies on screening inbred lines for waterlogging tolerance in maize have been conducted (RESULT_38), but without specific reference to HPC-4.

search_metadata.evidence_digest:
SVPMH-101 is a pearl millet (bajra) hybrid, not a maize hybrid. The AICPMIP table lists it as "SVPMH-101 (MSH 361)" under pearl millet hybrids. The Seednet name "PMH 10" under MAIZE refers to a different product, so no PMH 10 evidence is used below.

STRESS TOLERANCE
- Described as highly resistant to downy mildew, tolerant to rust and insect pests -- https://www.aicpmip.res.in/varietiesreleased.pdf
- Stress-tolerance claims about drought or heat were not found for this variety. The source lists only disease and pest traits. -- https://www.aicpmip.res.in/varietiesreleased.pdf

DISEASE AND PEST
- Highly resistant to downy mildew, tolerant to rust and insect pests -- https://www.aicpmip.res.in/varietiesreleased.pdf
- Resistant to downy mildew is also listed in the same table row block, which is garbled in the extracted text. -- https://www.aicpmip.res.in/varietiesreleased.pdf

AGRONOMY AND TRIALS
- Late maturing, tall, very compact, with long panicles and dual purpose (grain and fodder) use; high grain and fodder yield; grey-brown globular seeds -- https://www.aicpmip.res.in/varietiesreleased.pdf
- No multi-location trial data or yield numbers were found for this variety. -- No evidence found in search results.

GENETICS AND QTL
- No evidence found. The only parentage record is the AICPMIP table entry, which lists SVMSA-112 x SVR-50 for SVPMH-101. This cell is garbled in the extracted text, so verify it against the original table. -- https://www.aicpmip.res.in/varietiesreleased.pdf

BREEDER AND INSTITUTION
- Developer is Shakti Vardhak Hybrid Seeds Pvt. Ltd. (institution named in the record). No breeder name was found for SVPMH-101. -- No evidence found.

search_metadata.evidence_digest:
STRESS TOLERANCE
- PMH 10 is described as an early-maturing maize hybrid with heat and drought tolerance, though this is from a general listicle that also gives conflicting maturity and yield figures for PMH 10 (80-85 days and 70-80 q/acre in one place, 95-100 days and 50-60 q/acre in another). Treat as unverified. -- https://krishijagran.com/agripedia/maize-profit-booster-choose-the-best-high-yield-varieties-for-smart-farming-in-2025/
- The same listicle claims cold-stress resistance for PMH 10, which is not supported elsewhere in the results. -- https://krishijagran.com/agripedia/maize-profit-booster-choose-the-best-high-yield-varieties-for-smart-farming-in-2025/
- No evidence found for BLPMH 109 or MSH 363 stress tolerance. The BLPMH 109 search returned only unrelated US patents for other maize varieties.

DISEASE AND PEST
- No evidence found for PMH 10 disease or pest resistance. The moderate resistance to maydis leaf blight, charcoal rot and stem borer that appears in search results refers to PMH-13, a different PAU hybrid, so it is discarded. -- https://www.tribuneindia.com/news/punjab/punjab-agricultural-university-develops-new-hybrid-variety-of-maize-261049
- No evidence found for BLPMH 109 or MSH 363.

AGRONOMY AND TRIALS
- In a spring-maize irrigated trial, PMH 10 (described there as a PAU Ludhiana hybrid) gave about 68.71 q/ha grain yield, below P 1844 (85.46 q/ha) and DKC 9108 (69.55 q/ha). The page shows no trial year or site. -- https://www.researchgate.net/publication/327135097_Evaluation_of_Spring_Maize_Hybrids_under_Irrigated_Conditions
- A rabi maize page reports an average PMH 10 yield of 31.6 q/acre. -- https://www.apnikheti.com/en/pn/agriculture/crops/cereals/maize-rabi
- No evidence found for BLPMH 109 or MSH 363 field trials.

GENETICS AND QTL
- No evidence found for PMH 10, BLPMH 109 or MSH 363. The results contained only US patent documents for unrelated Pioneer and other maize lines.

BREEDER AND INSTITUTION
- The only PMH 10 institutional record found lists it as a hybrid from PAU, Ludhiana, Punjab, released through AICRP on Maize. -- https://iimr.icar.gov.in/cultivars-2/
- Conflict: the record names Limagrain India as the institution, but no evidence links PMH 10 or BLPMH 109 or MSH 363 to Limagrain. The Limagrain pages found are for other LG-series hybrids and are discarded.
- No breeder or scientist name for PMH 10 was found in any result.
- Conflict: the record says the crop is millet, but the Seednet crop is maize, and all PMH 10 evidence is maize. The pearl-millet PMH hybrids found on an IFFDC page are a different crop and are discarded. -- https://iffdc.in/post_detail.php?postname=availability-of-seed

CONTACT DETAILS
- No institute-level or breeder contact was found for PAU or for the ICAR Indian Institute of Maize Research in the results. The IIMR page gives no contact details in the retrieved text.
- KVK Langroya (district Shaheed Bhagat Singh Nagar, Punjab) is listed as the seed-sale contact for PMH 10: Assistant Director, phone 01823-292314 and 8968522800. No email or postal address was shown. The listing is about 1358 days old. -- https://www.apnikheti.com/en/pn/updates-detaills/maize-variety-pmh-10-available-at-krishi-vigyan-kendra-langroya/1192
- No contact details found for BLPMH 109 or MSH 363 or Limagrain India in relation to this variety.

PUBLICATIONS
- Authors not shown (year not shown). Evaluation of Spring Maize Hybrids under Irrigated Conditions. ResearchGate PDF -- https://www.researchgate.net/publication/327135097_Evaluation_of_Spring_Maize_Hybrids_under_Irrigated_Conditions
- No peer-reviewed paper, AICRP/ICAR annual report, KrishiKosh thesis or DOI was found for PMH 10, BLPMH 109 or MSH 363. The search was not designed to return KrishiKosh records directly, so this is a search gap rather than confirmed absence.

SEED AVAILABILITY
- PMH 10 seed was listed for sale at KVK Langroya at Rs 200/kg, in limited quantity. -- https://www.apnikheti.com/en/pn/updates-detaills/maize-variety-pmh-10-available-at-krishi-vigyan-kendra-langroya/1192
- No evidence found for BLPMH 109 or MSH 363 seed at NSC, a state seed corporation, an SAU or a dealer. The Limagrain product pages found are for LG-series hybrids and are not this variety.

RECOMMENDED STATES
- The IIMR cultivar list records PMH 10 under Punjab only. -- https://iimr.icar.gov.in/cultivars-2/
- A listicle says PMH 10 suits Punjab, Rajasthan and Gujarat. This is unverified. -- https://krishijagran.com/agripedia/maize-profit-booster-choose-the-best-high-yield-varieties-for-smart-farming-in-2025/
- No evidence found supporting the input list (Gujarat, Rajasthan, Uttar Pradesh, Punjab, Maharashtra, Tamil Nadu, Telangana) for BLPMH 109 or PMH 10.
- The IIMR list gives a release date of 22-11-2016, which differs from the 2022-06-17 release year in the input record. This should be checked against the CSC minutes.
