EVIDENCE DIGEST: CR DHAN 303 (variety_name "CR DHAN 303"; seednet_variety_name "CR DHAN-303"; crop rice; code CR 2649-7, IET 21589)

Search status: the search tool's usage limit was reached after four queries, so the searches for contacts, stress/disease, and most research papers could not be completed. Headings marked "NOT RETRIEVED" are gaps in this search, not confirmed absence of evidence. The searches used the spelling "CR DHAN 303"; the one retrieved source that names the variety uses "CR Dhan 303". The evidence below refers to that same variety. No result used the Seednet spelling "CR DHAN-303" directly, so the Seednet portal entry was not checked.

STRESS TOLERANCE -- NOT RETRIEVED. No drought, heat, salinity, flood, or submergence data was retrieved. Search for this specifically before use.

DISEASE AND PEST -- NOT RETRIEVED. No blast, bacterial leaf blight, sheath blight, or insect resistance data was retrieved.

AGRONOMY AND TRIALS -- Developed from a cross of Udaya and IET 16611; a production-technology document describes it as semi-dwarf (about 100-110 cm), with medium slender translucent grains and a kharif duration of about 118-125 days; it reports yield gains of about 36.6% over the station check, 20.0% over the state check, 9.1% over the national check, and 23.5% and 26.4% over two other checks (exact check names not retrieved) -- https://www.academia.edu/118613495/Production_Technology_for_rice_variety_CR_Dhan_303

GENETICS AND QTL -- NOT RETRIEVED. Parentage is partly established (Udaya x IET 16611, from the production-technology document above); no marker or QTL study was retrieved.

BREEDER AND INSTITUTION -- The production-technology document says the variety was released and notified by the Central Sub-Committee on Crop Standards, Notification and Release of Varieties for Agricultural Crops in 2014 -- https://www.academia.edu/118613495/Production_Technology_for_rice_variety_CR_Dhan_303. The developing institute and lead breeder were not named in the retrieved text. The "CR Dhan" naming and a related-paper listing on an NRRI variety paper suggest ICAR-National Rice Research Institute (NRRI), Cuttack, but this is unconfirmed -- https://www.academia.edu/113528689/CR_Dhan_801_and_CR_Dhan_802_Climate_Smart_Rice_Varieties_of_NRRI

CONTACT DETAILS -- NOT RETRIEVED. No breeder name, email, phone, or postal address was found. Recommended institute contact to check: NRRI Cuttack official site (icar.org.in / nrri.nic.in), which should be verified directly.

PUBLICATIONS --
Production Technology for rice variety CR Dhan 303. Authors not retrieved (2024 or earlier; year not retrieved). Document title as listed; no journal/report identified -- https://www.academia.edu/118613495/Production_Technology_for_rice_variety_CR_Dhan_303
Further papers, AICRP/ICAR reports, KrishiKosh theses, and DOIs: NOT RETRIEVED.

SEED AVAILABILITY -- NOT RETRIEVED. No NSC, state seed corporation, KVK, SAU, or dealer listings were retrieved. Check seednet.gov.in under "CR DHAN-303" and the Madhya Pradesh, Uttar Pradesh, and Chhattisgarh/Odisha seed agencies (state names to be confirmed).

RECOMMENDED STATES -- The production-technology document says the release covers irrigated areas of Madhya Pradesh, Uttar Pradesh, and at least one further state (the list is truncated in the retrieved text) -- https://www.academia.edu/118613495/Production_Technology_for_rice_variety_CR_Dhan_303. drought.details: CR Dhan 319 is a short-duration, drought-tolerant rice variety suitable for direct sown rainfed conditions, as well as irrigated and rainfed medium areas. A novel abiotic stress responsive gene, LOC_. Os06g10210 (OsCHI2), associated with drought tolerance, was isolated from this cultivar.

heat.details: The variety exhibits heat stress tolerance and has been included in screening for high temperature tolerance in rice genotypes, contributing to the development of abiotic tolerant rice varieties.

salinity.details: CR Dhan 319 is tolerant to coastal salinity.

flood.details: The variety is moderately tolerant to stagnant flooding.

disease_resistance.summary: No specific disease resistance level is explicitly stated for CR Dhan 319 across the provided results, though it is mentioned in contexts related to breeding for blast, bacterial leaf blight (BLB), false smut, and other biotic stress tolerance.

pest_resistance.summary: No specific pest resistance level is explicitly stated for CR Dhan 319 across the provided results.

agronomic_details.yield: 6.0 t/ha (calculated from 0.600 kg m2-1)
agronomic_details.stability: Not explicitly stated.
agronomic_details.adaptation: Suitable for irrigated areas, rainfed medium, and direct sown rainfed conditions.
agronomic_details.plant_characteristics: Semi-dwarf (82 cm height), with long slender (LS) grains.
agronomic_details.field_trials: CR Dhan 319 was identified by the Variety Identification Committee (VIC) in 2021. It has been included in the Draft Proceedings of the Annual Rice Group Meetings (56th, 57th, and 59th), indicating its participation in multi-location screening for various stress tolerances including drought, heat, submergence, salinity, and anaerobic germination. It also demonstrated superior performance in studies on growth, phenophases, and growing degree days requirements.

search_metadata.evidence_digest:
CR Dhan-337 (rice) -- evidence digest

Name check: variety_name "CR Dhan-337" and seednet_variety_name "CR DHAN-337" differ only in case. The evidence below refers to the same name under both. Four web_search queries were run. The only source that names CR Dhan 337 is one ICAR-CRRI variety table. Most headings therefore show "No evidence found".

STRESS TOLERANCE
- Listed in the ICAR-CRRI (Cuttack) table of varieties released 1968-2024 with the notes "highly tolerant to LF (leaf folder), stem borer (dead heart) and whorl maggot"; the PDF text is garbled, so confirm against the original -- https://icar-crri.in/wp-content/uploads/2025/11/CRRIs-varieties-1968-2024.pdf
- Drought, heat, salinity, flood and submergence tolerance: No evidence found for CR Dhan 337 (the table gives no such entries) -- https://icar-crri.in/wp-content/uploads/2025/11/CRRIs-varieties-1968-2024.pdf

DISEASE AND PEST
- Reaction listed as "MR to neck blast, leaf blast, BLB, sheath rot, RTD and GD" (MR = moderately resistant; BLB = bacterial leaf blight; RTD = rice tungro disease; GD = grassy stunt-type disease code as printed in the table; verify the expansion) -- https://icar-crri.in/wp-content/uploads/2025/11/CRRIs-varieties-1968-2024.pdf
- Pest reaction as printed: highly tolerant to leaf folder, stem borer (dead heart) and whorl maggot -- https://icar-crri.in/wp-content/uploads/2025/11/CRRIs-varieties-1968-2024.pdf

AGRONOMY AND TRIALS
- Table entry: early-duration, transplanted ecosystem, 2024, CVRC release, duration printed as approximately 113-118 days, long-slender grain (LS). Yield: not reliably parsed from the garbled table; no evidence found -- https://icar-crri.in/wp-content/uploads/2025/11/CRRIs-varieties-1968-2024.pdf
- Multi-location or field-trial results for CR Dhan 337: No evidence found -- https://icar-crri.in/wp-content/uploads/2025/11/CRRIs-varieties-1968-2024.pdf (no further trial source located)

GENETICS AND QTL
- Parentage (record says "Not specified"): No evidence found in any search result
- QTL or marker studies: No evidence found

BREEDER AND INSTITUTION
- The source table lists CR Dhan 337 under "Rice varieties developed by ICAR-CRRI, Cuttack during 1968-2024". The record says ICAR-National Rice Research Institute (NRRI). The NRRI name is the 2015 rename of CRRI, per https://testbook.com/ias-preparation/central-rice-research-institute, so both names refer to the Cuttack institute. Breeder name(s): No evidence found -- https://icar-crri.in/wp-content/uploads/2025/11/CRRIs-varieties-1968-2024.pdf
- Development station: Cuttack, Odisha (institute headquarters) -- https://arch-india.org/institution/central-rice-research-institute

CONTACT DETAILS
- No breeder email, phone or contact page found for CR Dhan 337
- Institute-level address as printed in another CRRI crop-improvement affiliation: "Crop Improvement Division, Central Rice Research Institute, Cuttack (753006), Odisha, India" -- https://www.scielo.br/j/cbab/a/NQVPpC3bCvm6KtXQS4jzf8F/?lang=en (affiliation only; not verified as current contact)
- Official email or phone: No evidence found in search results

PUBLICATIONS
- No peer-reviewed paper, AICRP/ICAR report, thesis or conference paper on CR Dhan 337 was found. Papers found concern other varieties (for example CR Dhan 801, CR Dhan 310) and were excluded.
- KrishiKosh (krishikosh.egranth.ac.in) theses for CR Dhan 337: No evidence found (not directly searched; no result returned)

SEED AVAILABILITY
- No evidence found for CR Dhan 337 from NSC, state seed corporations, KVKs, SAUs or dealers. The seed-related results returned were about other varieties or general dealer listings.

RECOMMENDED STATES
- Odisha, Bihar, West Bengal, Jharkhand -- https://icar-crri.in/wp-content/uploads/2025/11/CRRIs-varieties-1968-2024.pdf (table lists "CVRC (Odisha, Bihar, WB, JH)"; this matches the record's recommended_states_raw)
- Release year 2024 is consistent with the table entry (record date 2024-08-02)

Gaps to close: obtain the CVRC/SVRC gazette notification, a Seednet entry for CR DHAN-337, and breeder contacts from the ICAR-NRRI website (icar-nrri.in).

search_metadata.evidence_digest:
EVIDENCE DIGEST: CR Dhan 501 (IET 19189), rice

Name note: the CSC/notification name and the Seednet name were both searched as "CR Dhan 501". No Seednet portal page for this variety came up in the results, so every finding below refers to the CR Dhan 501 name in general sources. Sources use "CR Dhan-501" and "CR DHAN-501" interchangeably.

STRESS TOLERANCE:
- Developed for medium/semi-deep waterlogged areas, and reported to withstand static waterlogging of about 50-75 cm depth -- https://www.deccanherald.com/india/rice-variety-developed-water-logged-2517121
- Rated highly tolerant to leaf folder, stem borer (dead heart) and whorl maggot, and moderately tolerant to gall midge biotype 1 and white ear stem borer -- https://icar-crri.in/released-varieties/
- Described as lodging resistant and suitable for semi-deep and low-lying land -- https://www.sentinelassam.com/cities/guwahati-city/assam-scientists-develop-high-protein-climate-smart-rice-varieties-477392
- Flood-prone and waterlogged-area targeting reported in press coverage -- https://fasalkranti.in/cr-dhan-501/

DISEASE AND PEST:
- Resistant to neck blast; plant height about 135 cm -- https://icar-crri.in/released-varieties/
- Resistant to neck blast per the NRRI bulletin table -- https://icar-nrri.in/wp-content/uploads/2022/06/RB-37.pdf
- SRBSDV (virus) prevention measures discussed in regional press (Hindi) -- https://biharagro.com/crri-launches-cr-dhan-501-for-waterlogged-rice/
- Bihar notified-variety listing gives no disease data -- https://dbtagriculture.bihar.gov.in/licence/Document/Variety.pdf (listing only)

AGRONOMY AND TRIALS:
- Duration about 152 days (NRRI/CRRI listings); about 155 days (press) -- https://icar-crri.in/released-varieties/ ; https://biharagro.com/crri-launches-cr-dhan-501-for-waterlogged-rice/
- Yield potential 3.4 t/ha (listing); about 4.0 t/ha average (press) -- https://icar-crri.in/released-varieties/ ; https://biharagro.com/crri-launches-cr-dhan-501-for-waterlogged-rice/
- Long bold grain (listing) -- https://icar-crri.in/released-varieties/
- Assam RRL-RRS Gerua multi-location seed-sub-committee inclusion (recommended for Assam on Gerua trial performance) -- https://www.researchgate.net/figure/Characteristics-of-CR-Dhan-310-and-CR-Dhan-311_tbl2_338623089
- Not found: field-trial data from the AICRIP coordinated testing for this entry, beyond the summary listings above.

GENETICS AND QTL:
- Pedigree in the NRRI bulletin: segregating material of cross Ravana/Mahsuri -- https://icar-nrri.in/wp-content/uploads/2022/06/RB-37.pdf
- Pedigree in the NRRI listing: CR2008-111 (IET19189), with parent Savitri/Padmini. This conflicts with the bulletin's Ravana/Mahsuri pedigree; both are recorded, unresolved -- https://www.researchgate.net/publication/339527323_Rice_Varieties_of_NRRI_Yield_Quality_Special_Traits_and_Tolerance_to_Biotic_and_Abiotic_Stresses
- No QTL or marker study found.

BREEDER AND INSTITUTION:
- Developing institution: ICAR-National Rice Research Institute (NRRI), Cuttack, Odisha. Older sources call it Central Rice Research Institute (CRRI), Cuttack -- https://icar.org.in/node/1586 ; https://icar-crri.in/wp-content/uploads/2025/11/CRRIs-varieties-1968-2024.pdf
- Released by CVRC in 2010 (listing) and notified under S.O. 283(E) dated 07.02.2011 for Uttar Pradesh and Assam -- https://icar-crri.in/released-varieties/ ; http://www.drdpat.bih.nic.in/Notified-Rice-Varieties.htm
- Station/testing: RRL-RRS Gerua (Hajo), Assam, under ICAR-NRRI -- https://www.sentinelassam.com/cities/guwahati-city/assam-scientists-develop-high-protein-climate-smart-rice-varieties-477392
- Lead breeder name: No evidence found after searching.

CONTACT DETAILS:
- Breeder or scientist names, emails, phones and postal address: No evidence found after searching. The institute's own site (icar-nrri.in) was the only official source located and was not searched for contact pages.

PUBLICATIONS:
- Authors not stated (2022). High yielding varieties and their package of practices (ICAR-NRRI bulletin RB-37). ICAR-NRRI bulletin -- https://icar-nrri.in/wp-content/uploads/2022/06/RB-37.pdf
- Authors not stated (n.d.). Rice Varieties of NRRI: Yield, Quality, Special Traits and Tolerance to Biotic and Abiotic Stresses. ResearchGate -- https://www.researchgate.net/publication/339527323_Rice_Varieties_of_NRRI_Yield_Quality_Special_Traits_and_Tolerance_to_Biotic_and_Abiotic_Stresses
- Authors not stated (2025). ICAR-CRRI varieties 1968-2024 (release list). ICAR-CRRI -- https://icar-crri.in/wp-content/uploads/2025/11/CRRIs-varieties-1968-2024.pdf
- No peer-reviewed paper, KrishiKosh thesis or AICRP report specific to CR Dhan 501 was found.

SEED AVAILABILITY:
- Seed was distributed to select farmers in Odisha in the 2010-era coverage -- https://www.deccanherald.com/india/rice-variety-developed-water-logged-2517121
- No NSC, state seed corporation, KVK or dealer listing found. Seednet portal not reached. No evidence found after searching.

RECOMMENDED STATES:
- Uttar Pradesh and Assam (semi-deep water ecology) -- https://icar-nrri.in/wp-content/uploads/2022/06/RB-37.pdf ; http://www.drdpat.bih.nic.in/Notified-Rice-Varieties.htm
- Assam seed sub-committee inclusion -- https://www.researchgate.net/figure/Characteristics-of-CR-Dhan-310-and-CR-Dhan-311_tbl2_338623089

disease_resistance.summary: Moderately resistant to leaf blast, brown spot (BS), sheath rot (ShR), and rice tungro virus (RTV), per the Odisha varietal sheet (which describes it as moderately resistant to BL, BS, ShR, RTV, SB, GLH and LF). The CRRI list adds moderate resistance to neck blast and reports reaction data for bacterial leaf blight (BL) and brown spot, without a stated resistance level for BL in the digest. The NRRI variety table lists a high level of resistance to neck blast for this line. Cold tolerance is also recorded by CRRI, but this is not a disease trait.

pest_resistance.summary: Moderately resistant to stem borer (SB), leaf folder (LF) and green leaf hopper (GLH), per the Odisha varietal sheet. The CRRI list describes it as moderately tolerant to the listed pests. The digest gives no further pest reaction data.

agronomic_details.yield: Average yield of 7.2 t/ha, reported as 10.5% over IR 64, 9.3% over Krishna Hansa, 10.4% over local check and 17.7% over Gautam. Potential yield is listed as 5.6 t/ha (Odisha sheet and CRRI PDF) and as 7.8 t/ha on another CRRI snippet; these figures conflict and should be checked against the original minutes. A Sentinel Assam report gives a yield range of 3.5 to 5.6 t/ha.
agronomic_details.stability: Not found in searched sources. The digest provides no multi-environment stability data beyond the Boro-season performance cited at the 45th AICRIP workshop.
agronomic_details.adaptation: Boro rice area and Boro season. Listed as cold tolerant by CRRI, while the Odisha sheet records abiotic stress as minimal stress (conflict noted). Included in the Assam Seed Sub-Committee list of NRRI varieties for Assam based on performance at the Gerua station. A Sentinel Assam report describes use for Ahu, Sali and Boro seasons with duration of 115 to 145 days, which conflicts with the 160-day duration in other sources.
agronomic_details.plant_characteristics: Semi-dwarf stature (about 90 cm), medium-slender grain. Grain-quality and cooking traits (volume expansion, elongation and similar) are reported by the NRRI table, with the variety among those showing higher values.
agronomic_details.field_trials: (1) Released by the Central Sub-Committee on Crop Standards after high yield under Boro conditions at the 45th AICRIP workshop (08.04.2010). (2) Average yield of 7.2 t/ha, 10.5% over IR 64, 9.3% over Krishna Hansa, 10.4% over local check, and 17.7% over Gautam. (3) Potential yield conflicts between 5.6 t/ha and 7.8 t/ha across sources. (4) NRRI table reports higher values for grain-quality and cooking traits. (5) Assam Seed Sub-Committee included the variety in its NRRI list for Assam based on performance at the Gerua station. No trial-level data tables were found in the digest.

search_metadata.evidence_digest:
EVIDENCE DIGEST: CR Dhan 601 (rice)

Name note: The CSC release minutes name is "CR Dhan 601". The Seednet name is "CR DHAN-601". I did not retrieve any Seednet portal page, so every item below refers to "CR Dhan 601" in the release-minute or institute-listing sense. Seed-portal status is unverified.

Identifiers: The variety code IET 18558 appears with the line codes CRG1190-1 and IC584245. Notification number SO.10-11/2010-SO-IV is dated 10-10-2010, which matches the year field. The parentage field was "Not specified", but the source gives Jaya/IR 64 as the cross, made at the CRRI Regional Rainfed Lowland Research Station, Gerua, Assam. -- https://www.researchgate.net/publication/281062640_Cold_tolerant_rice_variety_CR_Boro_Dhan_601

STRESS TOLERANCE
- Listed as tolerant to cold, with a Boro ecology and 160-day duration (medium-slender, moderately tolerant to the listed pests). -- https://icar-crri.in/wp-content/uploads/2025/11/CRRIs-varieties-1968-2024.pdf
- Abiotic stress tolerance is recorded as "minimal stress" on the Odisha varietal sheet, which conflicts with the cold-tolerance entry above. -- https://rkb-odisha.in/wp-content/uploads/2024/09/cr-dhan-601-english.pdf
- No drought, heat, salinity, flood or submergence data found beyond the above.

DISEASE AND PEST
- Moderately resistant to leaf blast, brown spot, sheath rot, rice tungro virus, stem borer, leaf folder and green leaf hopper. The sheet describes it as moderately resistant to BL, BS, ShR, RTV, SB, GLH and LF. -- https://rkb-odisha.in/wp-content/uploads/2024/09/cr-dhan-601-english.pdf
- The CRRI list adds moderate resistance to neck blast and reaction data for bacterial leaf blight (BL), brown spot and related pests. -- https://icar-crri.in/released-varieties/ ; https://icar-crri.in/wp-content/uploads/2025/11/CRRIs-varieties-1968-2024.pdf
- The NRRI variety table also lists a high level of resistance to neck blast for this line. -- https://www.researchgate.net/publication/339527323_Rice_Varieties_of_NRRI_Yield_Quality_Special_Traits_and_Tolerance_to_Biotic_and_Abiotic_Stresses

AGRONOMY AND TRIALS
- Released by the Central Sub-Committee on Crop Standards after high yield under Boro conditions at the 45th AICRIP workshop (08.04.2010). -- https://www.researchgate.net/publication/281062640_Cold_tolerant_rice_variety_CR_Boro_Dhan_601
- Average yield of 7.2 t/ha, reported as 10.5% over IR 64, 9.3% over Krishna Hansa, 10.4% over local check and 17.7% over Gautam. -- https://www.researchgate.net/publication/281062640_Cold_tolerant_rice_variety_CR_Boro_Dhan_601
- Potential yield is listed as 5.6 t/ha (Odisha sheet and CRRI PDF) and as 7.8 t/ha on another CRRI snippet. These figures conflict and should be checked against the original minutes. -- https://rkb-odisha.in/wp-content/uploads/2024/09/cr-dhan-601-english.pdf ; https://icar-crri.in/released-varieties/
- The NRRI table reports grain-quality and cooking traits (volume expansion, elongation and similar), with the variety among those showing higher values. -- https://icar-nrri.in/wp-content/uploads/2020/01/Rice-Varieties-of-NRRI.pdf
- Suitable ecology is Boro rice area, season Boro, duration 160 days, semi-dwarf stature (about 90 cm), medium-slender grain. -- https://rkb-odisha.in/wp-content/uploads/2024/09/cr-dhan-601-english.pdf ; https://icar-crri.in/wp-content/uploads/2025/11/CRRIs-varieties-1968-2024.pdf

GENETICS AND QTL
- No QTL, marker-assisted or molecular-diversity study specific to CR Dhan 601 was found. The only genetic information is the Jaya/IR 64 cross and line codes given under the Identifiers note above. -- https://www.researchgate.net/publication/281062640_Cold_tolerant_rice_variety_CR_Boro_Dhan_601

BREEDER AND INSTITUTION
- Developing institute: Central Rice Research Institute, Cuttack, Odisha (now ICAR-National Rice Research Institute, Cuttack, per the institute's listing). The cross was made at the CRRI Regional Rainfed Lowland Research Station, Gerua, Assam. -- https://www.researchgate.net/publication/281062640_Cold_tolerant_rice_variety_CR_Boro_Dhan_601 ; https://icar-crri.in/released-varieties/
- The institute's variety listing (CVRC; the release year is given as 2010) is at -- https://icar-crri.in/released-varieties/
- Breeder name: not found. The only named author in the search results is Sachin Rautaray (ICAR-Indian Institute of Water Management, Bhubaneswar), who wrote the 2012 note. This is not confirmed as the breeder. -- https://www.researchgate.net/publication/281062640_Cold_tolerant_rice_variety_CR_Boro_Dhan_601

CONTACT DETAILS

official_quote.quote: Resistant to Leaf Blast & RTV

disease_resistance.research_summary: Moderately resistant to leaf blast, brown spot (BS), sheath rot (ShR), and rice tungro virus (RTV), per the Odisha varietal sheet (which describes it as moderately resistant to BL, BS, ShR, RTV, SB, GLH and LF). The CRRI list adds moderate resistance to neck blast and reports reaction data for bacterial leaf blight (BL) and brown spot, without a stated resistance level for BL in the digest. The NRRI variety table lists a high level of resistance to neck blast for this line. Cold tolerance is also recorded by CRRI, but this is not a disease trait.

pest_resistance.research_summary: Moderately resistant to stem borer (SB), leaf folder (LF) and green leaf hopper (GLH), per the Odisha varietal sheet. The CRRI list describes it as moderately tolerant to the listed pests. The digest gives no further pest reaction data.

drought.details: CR Dhan 807 is a drought-tolerant rice variety, suitable for direct-seeded rainfed upland areas. It has low moisture stress tolerance ability and is described as a 'water-less' rice variety.

heat.details: The provided search results do not explicitly mention heat tolerance for CR Dhan 807.

salinity.details: The variety is reported to be tolerant to salinity.

flood.details: CR Dhan 807 is tolerant to submergence and also exhibits anaerobic germination (AG) tolerance, which contributes to flood tolerance.

disease_resistance.summary: CR Dhan 807 is resistant to bacterial blight, brown spot, blast disease, and false smut.

pest_resistance.summary: The variety is resistant/tolerant to brown plant hopper (BPH), stem borer (dead heart), and leaf folder. It has been identified as a multiple pest resistant rice variety.

genetics_and_breeding.genetic_markers: CR Dhan 807 is a Marker-assisted selection (MAS) product. It was developed through marker-assisted backcross breeding from the well-known rice mega variety Sahbhagidhan, with a pedigree of Sahbhagidhan*4/ Robin. It is also described as a Near Isogenic Line (NIL).
genetics_and_breeding.qtl_information: Specific QTL names are not detailed, but the variety incorporates a herbicide tolerance gene (AHAS).
genetics_and_breeding.molecular_mechanisms: The herbicide tolerance in CR Dhan 807 is attributed to an AHAS gene, making it tolerant to the herbicide Imazethapyr.

seednet_fields.Parentage:
Vandana/ IR 64
Vandana: Drought tolerant, deep rooted most popular upland rice variety developed at CRURRS, Hazaribag having yield QTLs under drought (qDTY2.3, and qDTY3.2), but poor in terms of grain quality.
IR 64: It is very popular variety cultivated in all over India, with vary high yield potential, having tolerance to major buiotic stresses and superior grain quality features.
seednet_fields.Adaptation and recommended ecology: Jharkhand
seednet_fields.Agronomic Features: Highly responsive to fertilizers with moderately high agronomic N use efficiency and suitable for both early and late planting
seednet_fields.General Morphological Characteristics:
1.	Light green foliage
2.	Basal leaf sheath colour: green
3.	Flag leaf broad and semi-erect at flowering
4.	Intermediate stature
5.	Compact well exerted long panicle with distinct long slender grains and straw colour hull at maturity
seednet_fields.Reaction to Major Diseases: Resistant to blast moderately resistant to brown spot
seednet_fields.Reaction to Major Pests: Moderately tolerant
seednet_fields.Fertiliser Dosage (Kg/Ha): Fertilizer with 30 kg P2O5 & 30 kg MOP/ha as basal dose and 60 kg N/ha in two splits, half at 20 DAS and the second half at 35-40 DAS synchronizing with rains

disease_resistance.summary: Moderately resistant (MR) to leaf blast, neck blast, brown spot, sheath blight, sheath rot, stem borer, leaf folder and green leaf hopper (GLH); grain type MS. Evidence is from the CRRI released-variety listing and the RKB Odisha varietal sheet, which together support the MR ratings. The RKB sheet names only leaf blast, brown spot, sheath rot, stem borer, leaf folder and GLH. Unconfirmed: the CRRI released-variety page lists high tolerance to leaf folder, stem borer (dead heart) and whorl maggot, and moderate tolerance to gall midge biotype 1 and white ear-head stem borer. This text sits adjacent to the variety row in extraction, so it is likely but not confirmed for ANKIT.

search_metadata.evidence_digest:
NAME CHECK
- variety_name "CR Dhan 101 (Ankit)" (code CR 2702 / IET 21627) is the variety covered by the CRRI and Odisha sources below.
- seednet_variety_name "CR Dhan - 810" is a different variety. Sources list CR Dhan 810 as IET 30409, released in 2024 for rainfed shallow lowlands, and the evidence below for it does not describe ANKIT. No Seednet page for ANKIT was found in this run, and seednet.gov.in was not fetched directly.
- Release year conflict: the input says 2015-10-12, while the CRRI list gives 2014 (CVRC).
- Institution naming conflict: the input says Central Rice Research Institute, while the CRRI list is also hosted under ICAR-NRRI, Cuttack. Sources describe NRRI as formerly CRRI.

STRESS TOLERANCE
- CR Dhan 101 (Ankit) is described as an upland, medium-slender, 110-day variety with "minimal" abiotic stress tolerance; no drought, heat, salinity, flood or submergence tolerance is named for it -- https://rkb-odisha.in/wp-content/uploads/2024/09/cr-dhan-101-ankit-english.pdf
- Drought, heat, salinity, flood and submergence tolerance are otherwise not stated for ANKIT in any result -- No evidence found beyond the above.
- CR Dhan 810 (Seednet name, different variety): described as submergence-tolerant for rainfed areas of Odisha, West Bengal and Assam -- https://iki-india.com/public/index.php/single-news/UWZrSEl1dUR6OHVBRU4xMVZYVGMwUT09 (evidence refers to CR Dhan 810, not ANKIT)
- CR Dhan 810 (Seednet name, different variety): listed as suitable for rainfed shallow lowlands -- https://static.pib.gov.in/WriteReadData/specificdocs/documents/2024/aug/doc2024813374501.pdf (evidence refers to CR Dhan 810, not ANKIT)

DISEASE AND PEST
- CR Dhan 101 (Ankit): moderately resistant (MR) to leaf blast, neck blast, brown spot, sheath blight, sheath rot, stem borer, leaf folder and green leaf hopper; MS grain -- https://icar-crri.in/released-varieties/ and https://icar-crri.in/wp-content/uploads/2025/11/CRRIs-varieties-1968-2024.pdf
- CR Dhan 101 (Ankit): the same CRRI listing block also records high tolerance to leaf folder, stem borer (dead heart) and whorl maggot, and moderate tolerance to gall midge biotype 1 and white ear-head stem borer; the text is adjacent to the row in extraction, so treat as likely but unconfirmed for ANKIT -- https://icar-crri.in/released-varieties/
- CR Dhan 101 (Ankit): "moderately resistant" to leaf blast, brown spot, sheath rot, stem borer, leaf folder and GLH per the varietal sheet -- https://rkb-odisha.in/wp-content/uploads/2024/09/cr-dhan-101-ankit-english.pdf
- CR Dhan 810 (Seednet name, different variety): submergence tolerance; MR to leaf folder, stem borer and neck blast -- https://icar-crri.in/wp-content/uploads/2025/11/CRRIs-varieties-1968-2024.pdf (evidence refers to CR Dhan 810, not ANKIT)

AGRONOMY AND TRIALS
- CR Dhan 101 (Ankit): duration 110 days, semi-dwarf, upland ecology, suitable for both kharif and rabi; potential yield 3.9 t/ha -- https://rkb-odisha.in/wp-content/uploads/2024/09/cr-dhan-101-ankit-english.pdf
- CR Dhan 101 (Ankit): plant height about 100 cm; yield 3.98 t/ha -- https://icar-crri.in/released-varieties/
- CR Dhan 101 (Ankit): Odisha crop-cutting at Nuapada, 2020-21: 50.15 q/ha with hydrogel vs 45.5 q/ha without (10.2% increase) -- https://www.cifor-icraf.org/publications/pdf/reports/Odisha-Project-Report.pdf
- CR Dhan 101 (Ankit): one Odisha project report found it performing well in the short-duration group, alongside CR 201 -- https://www.cifor-icraf.org/publications/pdf/reports/Odisha-Project-Report.pdf
- CR Dhan 101 (Ankit): a yield of 5.4-6 t/ha is also listed in the NRRI released-variety block; the row association is unclear, so this is unconfirmed for ANKIT -- https://icar-crri.in/released-varieties/

GENETICS AND QTL
- CR Dhan 101 (Ankit): the NRRI compilation pairs the code CR2702 (IET 21627) with an entry that also lists IR78875/IR78877; parentage is not stated explicitly and this is unconfirmed -- https://www.researchgate.net/publication/339527323_Rice_Varieties_of_NRRI_Yield_Quality_Special_Traits_and_Tolerance_to_Biotic_and_Abiotic_Stresses
- No QTL or marker study naming ANKIT was found -- No evidence found.
- CR Dhan 810 (Seednet name, different variety): marker-assisted selection (MAS) breeding; the source does not name a QTL for it -- https://icar-crri.in/major-achievements/ (evidence refers to CR Dhan 810, not ANKIT)

BREEDER AND INSTITUTION
- CR Dhan 101 (Ankit): developed by ICAR-CRRI / ICAR-NRRI, Cuttack, Odisha; no lead breeder named -- https://icar-crri.in/wp-content/uploads/2025/11/CRRIs-varieties-1968-2024.pdf
- No breeder name for ANKIT was found -- No evidence found.
- Institute context: ICAR-NRRI (formerly CRRI) has released 139 varieties incl. three hybrids -- https://icar-nrri.in/wp-content/uploads/2020/01/Rice-Varieties-of-NRRI.pdf
- CR Dhan 810 (Seednet name, different variety): developed by ICAR-NRRI, Cuttack, Odisha -- https://icar-crri.in/nrri-rice-varieties-dedicated-to-the-nation-by-honble-prime-minister/ (evidence refers to CR Dhan 810, not ANKIT)
- Director named on the 2024 release-dedication page (institute-level, not a breeder of ANKIT): Dr. A.K. Nayak, Director, ICAR-NRRI, Cuttack -- https://icar-crri.in/nrri-rice-varieties-dedicated-to-the-nation-by-honble-prime-minister/

CONTACT DETAILS
- No official email, phone or postal address for the ANKIT breeding team or division was found in the results -- No evidence found.
- Institute-level web pages that appeared: ICAR-CRRI released-variety page -- https://icar-crri.in/released-varieties/ ; ICAR-NRRI site -- https://icar-nrri.in/wp-content/uploads/2022/04/RB-34.pdf (no address or phone was extracted from either page)
- Director (institute-level): Dr. A.K. Nayak, ICAR-NRRI, Cuttack; no email or phone found -- https://icar-crri.in/nrri-rice-varieties-dedicated-to-the-nation-by-honble-prime-minister/

PUBLICATIONS
- Authors not stated (year not stated; data 2020-21 referenced). Odisha project report with crop-cutting data for CR 101 (Ankit) at Nuapada and performance notes. Report -- https://www.cifor-icraf.org/publications/pdf/reports/Odisha-Project-Report.pdf
- Authors not stated (2020). Rice Varieties of NRRI: Yield, Quality, Special Traits and Tolerance to Biotic and Abiotic Stresses. Compilation listing CR Dhan 101 (Ankit) with CR2702 (IET 21627). ResearchGate -- https://www.researchgate.net/publication/339527323_Rice_Varieties_of_NRRI_Yield_Quality_Special_Traits_and_Tolerance_to_Biotic_and_Abiotic_Stresses
- Authors not stated (n.d.). Rice varieties/hybrids developed during 1968 to 2025, ICAR-CRRI list. Report -- https://icar-crri.in/wp-content/uploads/2025/11/CRRIs-varieties-1968-2024.pdf
- Peer-reviewed papers, theses (KrishiKosh), AICRP reports on ANKIT: No evidence found in this run.

disease_resistance.research_summary: Moderately resistant (MR) to leaf blast, neck blast, brown spot, sheath blight, sheath rot, stem borer, leaf folder and green leaf hopper (GLH); grain type MS. Evidence is from the CRRI released-variety listing and the RKB Odisha varietal sheet, which together support the MR ratings. The RKB sheet names only leaf blast, brown spot, sheath rot, stem borer, leaf folder and GLH. Unconfirmed: the CRRI released-variety page lists high tolerance to leaf folder, stem borer (dead heart) and whorl maggot, and moderate tolerance to gall midge biotype 1 and white ear-head stem borer. This text sits adjacent to the variety row in extraction, so it is likely but not confirmed for ANKIT.

search_metadata.evidence_digest:
STRESS TOLERANCE
Recommended for coastal saline areas, with the salinity claim repeated in several news and agency write-ups -- https://krishijagran.com/agripedia/cr-dhan-416-iet-30201-a-promising-rice-variety-for-coastal-saline-areas/ ; https://www.global-agriculture.com/india-region/pm-modi-unveils-climate-resilient-rice-variety-cr-dhan-416/
Drought, heat, flood and submergence tolerance: No evidence found for CR Dhan 416. Several results describe drought, submergence and heat tolerance, but for other varieties in the same release bundle, so I excluded them -- https://www.khetivyapar.com/en/prime-minister-modi-unveils-nine-high-yield-rice-varieties-3527
Salinity-tolerance QTL: the PIB release PDF has a table fragment mentioning Saltol and Xa21 near the CR Dhan 416 row, but the layout is too garbled to confirm the variety it refers to. Treat as unverified -- https://static.pib.gov.in/WriteReadData/specificdocs/documents/2024/aug/doc2024813374501.pdf

DISEASE AND PEST
Moderately resistant to brown spot, neck blast, sheath rot, rice tungro disease and glume discoloration -- https://www.global-agriculture.com/seed-industry/paddy-variety-cr-dhan-416-iet-30201/
Resistant to brown plant hopper, grasshopper and stem borer, per the same source -- https://www.global-agriculture.com/seed-industry/paddy-variety-cr-dhan-416-iet-30201/
Pest resistance also reported as a claim that reduces pesticide reliance -- https://www.global-agriculture.com/india-region/pm-modi-unveils-climate-resilient-rice-variety-cr-dhan-416/

AGRONOMY AND TRIALS
Yield 48.97 q/ha and maturity 125-130 days (no trial design, locations or years stated) -- https://www.global-agriculture.com/india-region/pm-modi-unveils-climate-resilient-rice-variety-cr-dhan-416/ ; https://static.pib.gov.in/WriteReadData/specificdocs/documents/2024/aug/doc2024813374501.pdf
Field-trial or multi-location data: the NRRI technical bulletin (below) is the only candidate source; its full text was not retrieved -- https://icar-crri.in/technical-bulletin/
Note: one source gives a 105-110 day, 6-7 t/ha semi-dwarf description attributed to IRRI, which conflicts with NRRI data and is probably about another variety. Not used -- https://www.cmv360.com/news/cr-dhan-416-a-high-yield-paddy-variety-at-low-cost

GENETICS AND QTL
No pedigree or parentage found. The parentage field is "Not specified" and no source gave one -- https://static.pib.gov.in/WriteReadData/specificdocs/documents/2024/aug/doc2024813374501.pdf
No QTL or marker study specific to CR Dhan 416 was found.

BREEDER AND INSTITUTION
Developed by ICAR-National Rice Research Institute, Cuttack, Odisha; released as part of the 109-variety package dedicated on 11 August 2024 -- https://icar-crri.in/nrri-rice-varieties-dedicated-to-the-nation-by-honble-prime-minister/ ; https://www.global-agriculture.com/india-region/pm-modi-unveils-climate-resilient-rice-variety-cr-dhan-416/
Likely lead scientists, from the author list of the NRRI bulletin on CR Dhan 416: B.C. Marndi, K. Chattopadhyay, L.K. Bose, R.P. Sah, Annie Poonam, M.K. Kar, K. Chakraborty, A.K. Mukherjee, S.D. Mohapatra, D. Moharana. Which of these is the lead breeder is not stated -- https://icar-crri.in/technical-bulletin/
NRRI director at the time of release: A.K. Nayak -- https://www.deccanherald.com/amp/story/india%2Fodisha%2Fodisha-rice-scientists-excited-as-pm-dedicates-three-varieties-developed-by-them-to-nation-3147823

CONTACT DETAILS
Breeder email, phone or personal contact: No evidence found.
Institute: ICAR-National Rice Research Institute, Cuttack, Odisha. No email, phone, postal address or contact-page URL appeared in the retrieved results. The official NRRI site has not been searched and should be checked before this record is finalised.

PUBLICATIONS
Marndi, B.C., Chattopadhyay, K., Bose, L.K., Sah, R.P., Poonam, A., Kar, M.K., Chakraborty, K., Mukherjee, A.K., Mohapatra, S.D., Moharana, D. (2026). A promising high yielding variety suitable for coastal saline areas: CR Dhan 416. ICAR-NRRI Technology Bulletin (the listing marks it as Bengali; the title and date are as listed, not verified against the PDF) -- https://icar-crri.in/technical-bulletin/
No peer-reviewed papers, AICRP/ICAR annual report entries, KrishiKosh theses or conference papers were found for CR Dhan 416 in this search. Coverage was limited to news and release-bundle sources, so this is a gap rather than confirmed absence.

SEED AVAILABILITY
No evidence found for CR Dhan 416 from NSC, state seed corporations, KVKs, SAU sales or dealers. The only seed listings retrieved were for other varieties (CR Dhan 69, MTU 1010) -- https://www.indiamart.com/jayadev-seeds/paddy-seeds.html
Seednet name check: the Seednet name "CR Dhan - 810" is a different variety from the CSC release name "CR Dhan 416". Results for CR Dhan 810 describe it as submergence-tolerant for rainfed areas of Odisha, West Bengal and Assam, which is not evidence for CR Dhan 416 -- https://iki-india.com/public/index.php/single-news/UWZrSEl1dUR6OHVBRU4xMVZYVGMwUT09 . No Seednet listing for CR Dhan 416 was retrieved, so the Seednet mapping should be checked directly on seednet.gov.in.

RECOMMENDED STATES
West Bengal, Maharashtra, Gujarat (matches the input field) -- https://static.pib.gov.in/WriteReadData/specificdocs/documents/2024/aug/doc2024813374501.pdf ; https://www.global-agriculture.com/seed-industry/paddy-variety-cr-dhan-416-iet-30201/
Release date: 2024-08-02 in the record, but news coverage dates the public unveiling to 11-12 August 2024. The exact notification date was not found and should be checked against the CSC or gazette record.

search_metadata.evidence_digest:
EVIDENCE DIGEST: CR Dhan-811 (rice)

Search status: The search tool hit its usage limit after four queries, so no further searches were possible. Every search returned material about CR Dhan 801 and CR Dhan 802, not CR Dhan-811. None of the results I retrieved mention CR Dhan-811, IET-30410, or the Seednet entry "CR Dhan - 811." The findings below are therefore either absent or relate to neighbouring varieties, and each is labelled that way. Treat this record as incomplete.

Name check: variety_name "CR Dhan-811" and seednet_variety_name "CR Dhan - 811" both returned zero hits, so no evidence refers to either name.

STRESS TOLERANCE
No evidence found for CR Dhan-811. Related NRRI climate-smart varieties CR Dhan 801 and CR Dhan 802 are described as addressing abiotic and biotic stresses made worse by climate change -- https://www.academia.edu/113528689/CR_Dhan_801_and_CR_Dhan_802_Climate_Smart_Rice_Varieties_of_NRRI (applies to CR Dhan 801/802, not CR Dhan-811)

DISEASE AND PEST
No evidence found for CR Dhan-811. No pest or disease data for CR Dhan 801/802 were visible in the retrieved snippets.

AGRONOMY AND TRIALS
No evidence found for CR Dhan-811. A case study of CR Dhan 801 performance in the Western Undulating Zone of Odisha, drawn from a NICRA project run by KVK Kalahandi (OUAT), exists -- https://www.researchgate.net/publication/379581355_Performance_of_Climate_Smart_Rice_var_CR_DHAN_801_A_Case_Study_from_Western_Undulating_Zone_of_Odisha_India (CR Dhan 801, not CR Dhan-811)

GENETICS AND QTL
No evidence found for CR Dhan-811. Parentage was not specified in the input and none was found. No marker or QTL study was retrieved.

BREEDER AND INSTITUTION
No breeder name found for CR Dhan-811. The NRRI climate-resilient variety listing on the institute's achievements page names CR Dhan 801 and other varieties, not CR Dhan-811 -- https://icar-crri.in/major-achievements/ (the domain is the former CRRI site; the page is a listing, not a CR Dhan-811 record)

CONTACT DETAILS
No breeder or institute contact details were retrieved in the search results. Institute-level contact should be verified directly on the ICAR-National Rice Research Institute (NRRI), Cuttack website, which I did not reach. I have not supplied an address, email, or phone from memory because I could not verify them.

PUBLICATIONS
Pradhan SK, Pandit E, Bose LK, Reddy JN, Pattanaik SSC, Meher J, Behera L. (year not shown in snippet). CR Dhan 801 and CR Dhan 802: Climate-Smart Rice Varieties of NRRI. Cited reference in ResearchGate performance paper -- https://www.researchgate.net/publication/379581355_Performance_of_Climate_Smart_Rice_var_CR_DHAN_801_A_Case_Study_from_Western_Undulating_Zone_of_Odisha_India (concerns CR Dhan 801/802, not CR Dhan-811)
Academia.edu entry, "CR Dhan 801 and CR Dhan 802 Climate-Smart Rice Varieties of NRRI" -- https://www.academia.edu/113528689/CR_Dhan_801_and_CR_Dhan_802_Climate_Smart_Rice_Varieties_of_NRRI (author and year not confirmed from snippet)
No peer-reviewed or KrishiKosh item for CR Dhan-811 was found.

SEED AVAILABILITY
No evidence found for CR Dhan-811 on Seednet, NSC, state seed corporations, KVKs, SAU sites, or dealers. The seed-availability query returned only the CR Dhan 801 performance study above.

RECOMMENDED STATES
The input lists Odisha and West Bengal, with release date 2024-08-02. Neither the release notification nor the state recommendation was confirmed by any retrieved source. The input record is the only source for these values.

Suggested follow-up (not yet searched): the CSC release minutes for CR Dhan-811 and IET-30410, the Seednet portal entry for "CR Dhan - 811," and the NRRI website for a breeder contact page.

search_metadata.evidence_digest:
STRESS TOLERANCE
CR Dhan 310 (Seednet name): Tolerant or moderately tolerant to leaf blast, brown spot, sheath rot, stem borer, gall midge biotype 1 and leaf folder, per NRRI release notice -- https://icar-nrri.in/icar-nrri-cuttack-releases-high-protein-rice-variety-cr-dhan-310/
CR Dhan 310 (Seednet name): Rated tolerant for neck blast, brown spot, sheath rot and rice tungro in an Odisha positioning sheet, which also lists 125-day duration and about 4.5-5.0 t/ha -- https://rkb-odisha.in/wp-content/uploads/2024/12/CR-Dhan-310.pdf
CR Dhan 310 (Seednet name): Described as a non-lodging plant type -- https://indiariceexpo.com/viewnews.aspx?id=35
CR Dhan 307 (variety_name; code Maudamani): Described as lodging resistant and suited to semi-deep and low-lying land, in a 2019-era Assam/NRRI statement that groups it with other CR Dhan lines -- https://www.sentinelassam.com/cities/guwahati-city/assam-scientists-develop-high-protein-climate-smart-rice-varieties-477392
CR Dhan 307: NRRI ResearchGate table fragment reads as resistant to neck blast and gall midge, moderately resistant to sheath rot and sheath blight, but the row attribution is unclear, so treat as unconfirmed -- https://www.researchgate.net/publication/339527323_Rice_Varieties_of_NRRI_Yield_Quality_Special_Traits_and_Tolerance_to_Biotic_and_Abiotic_Stresses
Drought, heat, salinity, flood and submergence: No evidence found for CR Dhan 307 or CR Dhan 310 on these specific stresses in the retrieved pages.

DISEASE AND PEST
CR Dhan 310: Tolerant or moderately tolerant reactions to the leaf blast, brown spot, sheath rot, stem borer, gall midge biotype 1 and leaf folder listing -- https://icar-nrri.in/icar-nrri-cuttack-releases-high-protein-rice-variety-cr-dhan-310/
CR Dhan 307: Possible neck blast and gall midge resistance in NRRI table fragment, row attribution unclear -- https://www.researchgate.net/publication/339527323_Rice_Varieties_of_NRRI_Yield_Quality_Special_Traits_and_Tolerance_to_Biotic_and_Abiotic_Stresses

AGRONOMY AND TRIALS
CR Dhan 307 (Maudamani): Field experiment at Pundibari, Coochbehar, West Bengal, kharif 2018, comparing planting densities; 15 cm x 15 cm spacing gave the highest dry matter, crop growth rate and net return -- https://www.researchgate.net/publication/355903489_Performance_of_rice_cultivar_CR_Dhan_307_Maudamani_as_influenced_by_different_planting_densities_in_terai_zone_of_West_Bengal
CR Dhan 307: NRRI listing gives 2014 release, about 135 days, Odisha, and 4.8 t/ha (values parsed from a table, verify against source) -- https://icar-crri.in/released-varieties/
CR Dhan 307: NRRI achievement page calls it one of three super rice releases in 2014 with 8.0 t/ha yield potential -- https://icar-crri.in/major-achievements/
CR Dhan 310: Multi-location AICRIP-Biofortification testing gave an average of 4483 kg/ha, 6.81% above the Samba Mahsuri check -- https://icar-nrri.in/icar-nrri-cuttack-releases-high-protein-rice-variety-cr-dhan-310/
CR Dhan 310: National average 4.5 t/ha, 10.2% protein, 120-125 days, 110 cm semi-dwarf, about 24 g 1000-grain weight, 97 days to 50% flowering -- https://icar-nrri.in/wp-content/uploads/2019/06/2.-leaflet_highprotein_final.pdf
CR Dhan 310: Scaled trials in Kandhamal, Odisha (2025, 65 farmers, 60 acres), reported yields about six quintals per acre, described as modest versus national trials -- https://thebetterindia.com/farming/high-protein-biofortified-rice-hidden-hunger-india-11193119
CR Dhan 310: Agronomy study (2025) in which CR Dhan 310 outyielded the farmers' variety Lalat with higher gross return and benefit-cost ratio of 1.7 -- https://www.agronomyjournals.com/archives/2025/vol8issue5/PartH/8-4-129-965.pdf

GENETICS AND QTL
CR Dhan 310 (IET24780; CR2829-PLN-37): Naveen x ARC10075 cross, with ARC10075 from Assam Rice Collection as high-protein donor and three backcrosses to Naveen -- https://rkb-odisha.in/wp-content/uploads/2024/12/CR-Dhan-310.pdf and https://icar-nrri.in/icar-nrri-cuttack-releases-high-protein-rice-variety-cr-dhan-310/
CR Dhan 310: Protein trait introgression via marker-assisted or QTL work: No evidence found in retrieved pages (only backcross-based selection described).
CR Dhan 307: Parentage: Not confirmed. The NRRI table fragment has a parentage string that may belong to a different row -- https://www.researchgate.net/publication/339527323_Rice_Varieties_of_NRRI_Yield_Quality_Special_Traits_and_Tolerance_to_Biotic_and_Abiotic_Stresses

BREEDER AND INSTITUTION
CR Dhan 310 (Seednet name): Developed by ICAR-National Rice Research Institute (NRRI), Cuttack; IET24780 -- https://icar-iirr.org/CRP/index.php/portfolio/1-visualize-impactful-mindshare
CR Dhan 310: Breeding team named in a 2025-era feature: Krishnendu Chattopadhyay (Principal Scientist, Plant Breeding, NRRI), Srigopal Sharma, Torit Baran Bagchi, Avijit Das and Bishnu Charan Marndi; team won ICAR Nanaji Deshmukh Award in 2018 -- https://thebetterindia.com/farming/high-protein-biofortified-rice-hidden-hunger-india-11193119
CR Dhan 310: Seed-stage and breeder seed coordination was handled by NRRI director A K Nayak as quoted in press -- https://indiariceexpo.com/viewnews.aspx?id=35
CR Dhan 307 (Maudamani): Developed by NRRI, Cuttack (2014 release list). Named breeder: No evidence found -- https://icar-crri.in/released-varieties/
CR Dhan 307: Assam-area scientist names (Rupankar Bhagawati, RRL-RRS Gerua) appear in press on CR Dhan 307 and related lines, but no attribution to CR Dhan 307 breeding was found, so not recorded as its breeder -- https://www.sentinelassam.com/cities/guwahati-city/assam-scientists-develop-high-protein-climate-smart-rice-varieties-477392

CONTACT DETAILS
No official email, phone or postal address for NRRI, a CR Dhan 307 breeder or a CR Dhan 310 breeder was found in the four searches. Institute contact page: No evidence found.
Institute website pages retrieved: https://icar-nrri.in/ (NRRI release notice and leaflet pages) and https://icar-iirr.org/CRP/index.php/crparticles?view=article&layout=edit&id=24 (NRRI profile)
Names and roles as found (not contact details): Krishnendu Chattopadhyay, Principal Scientist (Plant Breeding), ICAR-NRRI -- https://thebetterindia.com/farming/high-protein-biofortified-rice-hidden-hunger-india-11193119

search_metadata.evidence_digest:
STRESS TOLERANCE
Insect tolerance: rated highly tolerant to leaf folder, stem borer (dead heart) and whorl maggot; moderately tolerant to gall midge (biotype 1) and white-ear stem borer -- https://icar-crri.in/released-varieties/
Disease reaction (table code): moderately resistant to brown spot; WBPH is also listed among the pest codes -- https://icar-crri.in/released-varieties/
Abiotic stress (drought, heat, salinity, flood, submergence): No evidence found for CR Dhan 306 in the retrieved pages. The searched pages give no abiotic-stress rating for this variety.

DISEASE AND PEST
Leaf folder, stem borer and whorl maggot tolerance; gall midge biotype 1 and white-ear borer moderate tolerance; brown spot moderate resistance -- https://icar-crri.in/released-varieties/
Same tolerance codes in the institute's 1968-2024 variety list (entry 108) -- https://icar-crri.in/wp-content/uploads/2025/11/CRRIs-varieties-1968-2024.pdf

AGRONOMY AND TRIALS
Ecology: irrigated; release year 2014; duration 120-125 days; grain type SB (small bold) -- https://icar-crri.in/released-varieties/
Yield: 5.4-6 t/ha in the release list; the same list's line also shows 6.0-6.4 t/ha. The two ranges conflict and both are recorded here -- https://icar-crri.in/released-varieties/ ; https://icar-crri.in/released-varieties/ (line "GY-6.0-6.4 t/ha")
NRRI varieties comparison table lists CR Dhan 306 as irrigated, 6.2 t/ha, about 125 days -- https://www.researchgate.net/publication/339527323_Rice_Varieties_of_NRRI_Yield_Quality_Special_Traits_and_Tolerance_to_Biotic_and_Abiotic_Stresses
Multi-location or field-trial results specific to CR Dhan 306: No evidence found (the trial pages retrieved concern CR Dhan 310/311 and CR Dhan 801, not 306).

GENETICS AND QTL
No evidence found. No parentage, pedigree or QTL/marker record for CR Dhan 306 appeared. The record's parentage is "Not specified" and the search did not fill it.

BREEDER AND INSTITUTION
Developing institution (by release-list attribution): ICAR-National Rice Research Institute (NRRI), Cuttack, under the heading "Rice varieties developed by ICAR-NRRI, Cuttack during 1968-2019" -- https://icar-crri.in/released-varieties/
Same attribution in the Table 3 listing: "Rice varieties developed by ICAR-NRRI, Cuttack during 2010-2019" -- https://www.intechopen.com/chapters/77391
Lead breeder or scientist name: No evidence found. The "Developed by" field for CR Dhan 306 is blank in the retrieved list (the intechopen table reads "Developed by: NA" for a different hybrid).
Seednet name check: "CR Dhan 310" refers to a different variety. The CR Dhan 310 pages describe IET24780 (CR2829-PLN-37), a high-protein variety released for Odisha, Uttar Pradesh and Madhya Pradesh -- https://icar-iirr.org/CRP/index.php/portfolio/1-visualize-impactful-mindshare ; https://icar-nrri.in/icar-nrri-cuttack-releases-high-protein-rice-variety-cr-dhan-310/
Therefore the Seednet name "CR Dhan 310" does not match the CVRC 2014 release "CR Dhan 306" (IET 22084). Seednet-side evidence cannot be attributed to this record.

CONTACT DETAILS
Breeder contact: No evidence found.
Institute-level contact: No evidence found in the retrieved text. The NRRI pages found give no email, phone or postal address. Page URLs for the institute, if needed: https://icar-nrri.in/ (NRRI) and https://icar-crri.in/released-varieties/ (source of the release list; no contact block was retrieved from it).

PUBLICATIONS
Authors not shown in retrieved text (year not shown). Rice Varieties of NRRI: Yield, Quality, Special Traits and Tolerance to Biotic and Abiotic Stresses. ResearchGate (NRRI variety comparison, includes CR Dhan 306) -- https://www.researchgate.net/publication/339527323_Rice_Varieties_of_NRRI_Yield_Quality_Special_Traits_and_Tolerance_to_Biotic_and_Abiotic_Stresses
No peer-reviewed paper, AICRP/ICAR report, KrishiKosh thesis or conference paper specific to CR Dhan 306 appeared in the retrieved results. Papers on CR Dhan 310 exist (for example https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/38414353/) but are not attributed to this record.

SEED AVAILABILITY
No evidence found. The four searches run were variety/release, breeder, research and trial queries. A seed-availability search was not run because the 4-search budget was used, so this heading remains unchecked. Recommended next query: "CR Dhan 306 seed NSC SAU" or a seednet.gov.in check.

RECOMMENDED STATES
Madhya Pradesh, Bihar and Puducherry (CVRC recommendation) -- https://icar-crri.in/released-varieties/ ; https://www.intechopen.com/chapters/77391
The CVRC list also gives the state "Bihar" and "Puducherry" under the same entry -- https://icar-crri.in/wp-content/uploads/2025/11/CRRIs-varieties-1968-2024.pdf

search_metadata.evidence_digest:
EVIDENCE DIGEST: CR Dhan 315 (rice)

NAME NOTE (applies to all headings): The CSC name is "CR Dhan 315" (IET 27179). The Seednet name is "CR Dhan 310," but the sources identify CR Dhan 310 as a different rice variety (IET 24780, Naveen x ARC 10075, released 2016 for Odisha, Uttar Pradesh and Madhya Pradesh). I have discarded all CR Dhan 310 findings and attributed nothing from them to CR Dhan 315. No Seednet portal page for CR Dhan 315 was retrieved.

STRESS TOLERANCE
Name: CR Dhan 315 only.
- Drought, heat, salinity, flood and submergence tolerance: No evidence found. The searches returned no variety-specific abiotic stress data. The only abiotic context was general NRRI text on rice stresses. -- https://icar-nrri.in/wp-content/uploads/2019/02/Rice_Research_book_nrri.pdf
- Ecology: Irrigated, kharif, and rainfed shallow lowland suitability. -- https://www.researchgate.net/publication/383342601_Biofortified_Rice_Varieties_in_India_Key_to_Nutritional_Security

DISEASE AND PEST
Name: CR Dhan 315 only.
- Moderately tolerant to leaf blast, neck blast and brown spot; resistant to leaf folder; moderately resistant to stem borer. -- https://icar-crri.in/released-varieties/
- Same disease and pest reaction listed in the NRRI released-varieties table (the table entry is the same as the line above). -- https://icar-crri.in/released-varieties/

AGRONOMY AND TRIALS
Name: CR Dhan 315 only.
- Duration about 130 days; irrigated; medium slender grain (MS). -- https://icar-crri.in/released-varieties/
- Grain yield about 50.0 q/ha and maturity 130 days; designed for irrigated kharif conditions. -- https://krishijagran.com/agripedia/list-of-biofortified-rice-varieties-a-closer-look-at-nutrient-rich-options/
- Breeder-level yield and multi-location trial data: No evidence found. The Krishi Jagran yield figure is secondary and unreferenced.

GENETICS AND QTL
Name: CR Dhan 315 only.
- IET number 27179 and institute ID CR 2826-1-1-2-4B-2-1. -- https://www.researchgate.net/publication/383342601_Biofortified_Rice_Varieties_in_India_Key_to_Nutritional_Security
- Pedigree Swarna/ARC 10075 by bulk-pedigree breeding. -- https://www.researchgate.net/publication/383342601_Biofortified_Rice_Varieties_in_India_Key_to_Nutritional_Security
- High zinc trait (about 25 ppm in grain). -- https://www.thestatesman.com/india/icar-nrri-develops-bio-fortified-rice-varieties-1503137049.html ; also https://icar-crri.in/released-varieties/
- QTL or marker study specific to CR Dhan 315: No evidence found. The QTL material retrieved concerns CR Dhan 310 and 311 (protein QTL) and is discarded.

BREEDER AND INSTITUTION
Name: CR Dhan 315 only.
- Developing institution: ICAR-National Rice Research Institute (NRRI), Cuttack, Odisha. -- https://www.researchgate.net/publication/383342601_Biofortified_Rice_Varieties_in_India_Key_to_Nutritional_Security
- Lead breeder or scientist names for CR Dhan 315: No evidence found. No breeder name was attached to this variety in any retrieved page.
- NRRI's 1966 establishment at Bidhyadharpur, Cuttack is documented on Wikipedia, which is not an official source. -- https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/National_Rice_Research_Institute

CONTACT DETAILS
Name: CR Dhan 315 only. No breeder contact exists in the evidence, so institute-level information is given.
- Institute website domain shown on NRRI pages: icar-nrri.in (https://icar-nrri.in/wp-content/uploads/2019/02/Rice_Research_book_nrri.pdf). Official email, phone and postal address for the NRRI division: No evidence found in the retrieved text.
- Director A K Nayak is named in a 2024 PTI news report about NRRI varieties. This is a news quotation, not a contact record, and no contact details accompany it. -- https://www.deccanherald.com/amp/story/india%2Fodisha%2Fodisha-rice-scientists-excited-as-pm-dedicates-three-varieties-developed-by-them-to-nation-3147823

PUBLICATIONS
Name: CR Dhan 315 only. Peer-reviewed papers, AICRP reports and theses specific to CR Dhan 315: No evidence found.
- Authors not stated in retrieved text (2024, inferred from the upload date). Biofortified Rice Varieties in India: Key to Nutritional Security. NRRI Research Bulletin No. 48, ICAR-NRRI -- https://icar-crri.in/wp-content/uploads/2024/08/NRRI_Research-Bulletin-No-48.pdf (includes CR Dhan 315 in its list of released biofortified varieties and its trait data)
- Note on the same bulletin's ResearchGate copy: https://www.researchgate.net/publication/383342601_Biofortified_Rice_Varieties_in_India_Key_to_Nutritional_Security
- Krishikosh search: No CR Dhan 315 thesis or report was found. The one KrishiKosh hit was an unrelated aerobic hybrid thesis and is discarded.

SEED AVAILABILITY
Name: CR Dhan 315 only.
- Variety-specific seed source (Seednet, NSC, State Seed Corporation, KVK or SAU dealer): No evidence found.
- General only, not specific to CR Dhan 315: NRRI signed MoUs with private companies and farmers' producer companies for seed production and marketing of its biofortified varieties. -- https://www.thestatesman.com/india/icar-nrri-develops-bio-fortified-rice-varieties-1503137049.html
- The CR Dhan 310 seed-indent lists were discarded because they concern a different variety. -- https://icar-crri.in/major-achievements/

RECOMMENDED STATES
Name: CR Dhan 315 only.
- Released by the Central Variety Release Committee (CVRC) for Maharashtra and Gujarat. -- https://icar-crri.in/released-varieties/
- High zinc variety released for Gujarat and Maharashtra. -- https://www.thestatesman.com/india/icar-nrri-develops-bio-fortified-rice-varieties-1503137049.html
- Recommended for Maharashtra and Gujarat. -- https://krishijagran.com/agripedia/list-of-biofortified-rice-varieties-a-closer-look-at-nutrient-rich-options/

salinity.details: No evidence found. Searches for salinity tolerance returned nothing about CR Dhan 311.

flood.details: No evidence found. Searches for flood tolerance returned nothing about CR Dhan 311.

disease_resistance.summary: CRRI released-varieties listing gives CR Dhan 311 (Mukul) a tolerance code list of BL, GD, BS, RTD, BLB, MR-GM and SB (code expansions not given in the digest). The NRRI rice varieties review (ResearchGate) reports resistance to neck blast and gall midge and moderate resistance to sheath blight, and tabulates seedling blight and bakanae reactions, but the exact values were not extractable from the fragmentary search text and should be verified in the full PDF. Neck blast: resistant. Sheath blight: moderately resistant. Seedling blight and bakanae: reactions tabulated in the source, values not found in the digest. Gall midge is covered under pest resistance.

pest_resistance.summary: Gall midge: resistant according to the NRRI rice varieties review; the CRRI listing includes the code MR-GM in the tolerance code list. No other pest reactions found in the digest. Pest reaction field in the source record is 'Not Specified'.

agronomic_details.yield: Odisha on-farm multilocation trial (Kharif 2020-21 and 2021-22): 41.3 q/ha (about 4.13 t/ha). CRRI released-varieties listing: 5.54 t/ha. Krishijagran agripedia (secondary source): 46.2 q/ha. CSC record average_yield field is given only as units (Kg/Ha) with no value.
agronomic_details.stability: Not found beyond the Odisha multilocation assessment, which covered different agro-climatic zones of Odisha (per the 2025 publication title). No stability statistics were provided in the digest.
agronomic_details.adaptation: NRRI 2019 leaflet: suited to irrigated and favourable shallow rainfed areas. Krishijagran and the CRRI listing place it in Odisha. The CSC record lists Assam as the recommended state; the digest contains no Assam-specific evidence, so the discrepancy is noted here and the CSC value is retained as ground truth.
agronomic_details.maturity_days: 120-125 days (NRRI 2019 leaflet; ICAR-IIRR 2021 review). Krishijagran cites 124 days (secondary source).
agronomic_details.plant_characteristics: Semi-dwarf plant type, about 110-115 cm (NRRI 2019 leaflet); 110 cm (ICAR-IIRR 2021 review); plant height 107.5 cm in the Odisha trial. Long bold grain with good cooking and eating quality (NRRI 2019 leaflet). 1000-grain weight 22.2 g (Odisha trial). Grain quality: 10.1% protein and 20 ppm Zn (ICAR-IIRR 2021 review, described as the same as CR Dhan 310 in the digest, with the figures stated for CR Dhan 311).
agronomic_details.field_trials: Odisha on-farm multilocation trial, Kharif 2020-21 and 2021-22: CR Dhan 311 averaged 41.3 q/ha, plant height 107.5 cm and 1000-grain weight 22.2 g, compared with the check Lalat at 39.3 q/ha. No other trial results found in the digest.

genetics_and_breeding.genetic_markers: Not found in searched sources. No marker or QTL study specific to CR Dhan 311 alone was found.
genetics_and_breeding.qtl_information: NRRI 2019 leaflet states that CR Dhan 310 and CR Dhan 311 carry the grain-protein QTL qGPC1.1 on chromosome 1, identified in an ARC10075/Naveen backcross-derived population. Position and effect size not given in the digest. The leaflet attributes the QTL to both CR Dhan 310 and CR Dhan 311 jointly.

search_metadata.evidence_digest:
STRESS TOLERANCE
No evidence found. Searches for drought, heat, salinity, flood or submergence tolerance returned nothing about CR Dhan 311. The only tolerance-type entries were disease and pest codes (see DISEASE AND PEST).

DISEASE AND PEST
- The CRRI released-varieties listing gives CR Dhan 311 (Mukul) a tolerance code list of BL, GD, BS, RTD, BLB, MR-GM and SB, with 5.54 t/ha yield, and lists Odisha as the state -- https://icar-crri.in/released-varieties/
- An NRRI rice varieties review (ResearchGate) reports CR Dhan 311 as resistant to neck blast and gall midge and moderately resistant to sheath blight, and tabulates its seedling blight and bakanae reactions -- https://www.researchgate.net/publication/339527323_Rice_Varieties_of_NRRI_Yield_Quality_Special_Traits_and_Tolerance_to_Biotic_and_Abiotic_Stresses
- Caution: the NRRI review text is fragmentary in the search extract, so the exact resistance scores should be checked in the full PDF.

AGRONOMY AND TRIALS
- NRRI 2019 high-protein leaflet: medium duration (120-125 days), semi-dwarf plant type (about 110-115 cm), long bold grain, good cooking and eating quality, suited to irrigated and favourable shallow rainfed areas -- https://icar-nrri.in/wp-content/uploads/2019/06/2.-leaflet_highprotein_final.pdf
- ICAR-IIRR 2021 review page (ICAR-IIRR CRP article): CR Dhan 311 (Mukul) described with the same 10.1% protein and 20 ppm Zn, 120-125 days, 110 cm semi-dwarf -- https://icar-iirr.org/CRP/index.php/crparticles?view=article&layout=edit&id=24
- Odisha on-farm multilocation trial, Kharif 2020-21 and 2021-22 (International Journal of Research in Agronomy, 2025): CR Dhan 311 averaged 41.3 q/ha, plant height 107.5 cm, 1000-grain weight 22.2 g, compared with Lalat at 39.3 q/ha -- https://www.agronomyjournals.com/archives/2025.v8.i5.H.2951
- Krishijagran agripedia (secondary source): CR Dhan 311 quoted at 46.2 q/ha yield and 124-day maturity, adapted to Odisha -- https://krishijagran.com/agripedia/list-of-biofortified-rice-varieties-a-closer-look-at-nutrient-rich-options/

GENETICS AND QTL
- NRRI 2019 leaflet: CR Dhan 310 and CR Dhan 311 are stated to carry the grain-protein QTL (qGPC1.1) on chromosome 1, identified in an ARC10075/Naveen backcross-derived population -- https://icar-nrri.in/wp-content/uploads/2019/06/2.-leaflet_highprotein_final.pdf
- No marker or QTL study specific to CR Dhan 311 alone was found.

BREEDER AND INSTITUTION
- No named breeder for CR Dhan 311 was found. The authors of the 2019 NRRI proceedings paper on CR Dhan 310 and 311 are listed as publication authors only, not as confirmed breeders of this variety -- https://www.semanticscholar.org/paper/CR-Dhan-310-and-CR-Dhan-311-High-Protein,-Rice-of-Chattopadhyay-Sharma/d1aeea256079b6c8cd5f6b9044c31c4f2f76beeb
- Developing institution: ICAR-National Rice Research Institute (NRRI), Cuttack, Odisha, as stated in the 2019 leaflet. The CSC record's "ICAR-National Research Institute" is incomplete -- https://icar-nrri.in/wp-content/uploads/2019/06/2.-leaflet_highprotein_final.pdf
- The icar-crri.in domain (ICAR-CRRI, Cuttack) carries the same NRRI variety list, consistent with the institute's former name -- https://icar-crri.in/released-varieties/

CONTACT DETAILS
- Institute-level address only: ICAR-National Rice Research Institute, Cuttack 753006, Odisha -- https://icar-nrri.in/wp-content/uploads/2019/06/2.-leaflet_highprotein_final.pdf
- No breeder name, official email, phone number or institute contact-page URL was found in any result. The search budget (4 queries) was used before a dedicated contact search could be run.

disease_resistance.research_summary: CRRI released-varieties listing gives CR Dhan 311 (Mukul) a tolerance code list of BL, GD, BS, RTD, BLB, MR-GM and SB (code expansions not given in the digest). The NRRI rice varieties review (ResearchGate) reports resistance to neck blast and gall midge and moderate resistance to sheath blight, and tabulates seedling blight and bakanae reactions, but the exact values were not extractable from the fragmentary search text and should be verified in the full PDF. Neck blast: resistant. Sheath blight: moderately resistant. Seedling blight and bakanae: reactions tabulated in the source, values not found in the digest. Gall midge is covered under pest resistance.

pest_resistance.research_summary: Gall midge: resistant according to the NRRI rice varieties review; the CRRI listing includes the code MR-GM in the tolerance code list. No other pest reactions found in the digest. Pest reaction field in the source record is 'Not Specified'.

search_metadata.evidence_digest:
I used all four permitted searches, and the tool then refused a fifth call. Several headings therefore have no evidence, and the one bulletin I found was only seen as a listing, not read in full.

Variety name: the CSC minutes name and the Seednet name are both "CR Dhan 323 (Jyotsna)", so every finding below refers to that name. Only the Seednet-style code A010218036 and the input-record fields (release date 2023-05-02, Odisha, parentage CRHR 32 (CRMS 31A x CRL22R)) came from the input, not from search.

STRESS TOLERANCE: No evidence found.

DISEASE AND PEST: No evidence found.

AGRONOMY AND TRIALS: A production-technology bulletin titled "Production Technology for CR Dhan 323 (Jyotsna)" is listed on the NRRI technical bulletin page -- https://icar-crri.in/technical-bulletin/ (listing only; the bulletin's content was not retrieved, so no yield, maturity or management figures are recorded).

GENETICS AND QTL: No evidence found. The parentage CRHR 32 (CRMS 31A x CRL22R) is from the input record and was not verified by search.

BREEDER AND INSTITUTION: Institution per input record: ICAR-National Rice Research Institute. The bulletin listing gives the authors as S. Samataray, R.L. Verma, Nupur Naik and Parameswaran (further names truncated in the listing) -- https://icar-crri.in/technical-bulletin/. No source confirmed these authors as the lead breeders of the variety.

CONTACT DETAILS: No evidence found. No official email, phone, postal address or contact-page URL for NRRI or the variety's breeders appeared in the results.

PUBLICATIONS:
Samataray, S.; Verma, R.L.; Naik, N.; Parameswaran et al. (year not shown). Production Technology for CR Dhan 323 (Jyotsna). Technical bulletin, ICAR-NRRI -- https://icar-crri.in/technical-bulletin/
No peer-reviewed papers, AICRP/ICAR reports, theses (KrishiKosh) or QTL studies were found in the searches.

SEED AVAILABILITY: No evidence found. No NSC, state seed corporation, KVK, SAU or dealer listing was retrieved.

RECOMMENDED STATES: No evidence found in search. Odisha is from the input record only.

Other sources seen: a global-agriculture.com page lists "Rice Variety CR Dhan 323 (Jyotsna)" among related posts, with no details -- https://www.global-agriculture.com/seed-industry/rice-variety-cr-dhan-324-abhaya-paushtik/ . Its CR Dhan 328 notification item concerns a different variety and was not used.

Next steps: check the NRRI site (nrri.icar.gov.in, an official ICAR site I did not reach), the Seednet portal, and KrishiKosh directly for the release notification, breeder contacts, trial data and seed sources.

No seednet.gov.in page was returned by any search, so every finding below refers to the variety name as used in news reports and NRRI or ICAR documents, not to a Seednet record. Search budget used: 4 of 4.

STRESS TOLERANCE

DISEASE AND PEST
- The IIRR 2023 annual report table gives a short reaction code for CR Dhan 324 ("MR-BS, GM") but does not expand the abbreviations, so I cannot confirm which diseases or pests these refer to. -- https://icar-iirr.org/AnnualReports/IIRR_AR_2023.pdf
- Resistance profile is otherwise not documented in the sources found. -- https://icar-iirr.org/AnnualReports/IIRR_AR_2023.pdf

AGRONOMY AND TRIALS
- Listed as a doubled haploid line, with a 5.5 t/ha yield entry and long slender grain in the IIRR 2023 table. The same table gives maturity as 85-90 days, which conflicts with the 120-125 day figures given for other NRRI biofortified releases; treat the maturity value as unverified. -- https://icar-iirr.org/AnnualReports/IIRR_AR_2023.pdf
- Nutritional profile: about 11% grain protein and about 22-23 ppm zinc, with 2.5 ppm iron reported in one NRRI bulletin. -- https://icar-crri.in/wp-content/uploads/2024/08/NRRI_Research-Bulletin-No-48.pdf ; https://icar-crri.in/wp-content/uploads/2024/08/NRRI_Research-Bulletin-No-55.pdf

- Multi-location trial data: No evidence found beyond the single yield entry above.

GENETICS AND QTL
- Developed through the doubled haploid approach. -- https://icar-crri.in/wp-content/uploads/2024/08/NRRI_Research-Bulletin-No-48.pdf

- QTL or marker-assisted work specific to CR Dhan 324: No evidence found. The QTL study located in the search results (qGPC1.1) relates to a different NRRI population. -- https://icar-iirr.org/CRP/index.php/crparticles?view=article&layout=edit&id=24

BREEDER AND INSTITUTION
- Developing institution: ICAR-National Rice Research Institute, Cuttack. -- https://icar-crri.in/wp-content/uploads/2024/08/NRRI_Research-Bulletin-No-48.pdf

disease_resistance.summary: Bacterial blight (Xanthomonas oryzae pv. oryzae): the CRRI variety table lists resistance from the Xa4, xa5, Xa7, xa13 and Xa21 genes. A pathotyping study reports that no tested Xoo isolates were virulent on IRBB66, which carries this five-gene set; this is background on the donor and not a field test of CR Dhan 326. No evidence found for blast, sheath blight or other diseases specific to this variety.

pest_resistance.summary: Not found in searched sources. No evidence found for brown planthopper, gall midge or other pest resistance specific to this variety.

agronomic_details.yield: Average yield of 6.2 t/ha per the CRRI variety table. The original record lists average_yield as Kg/Ha with no value.
agronomic_details.stability: Not found in searched sources. The Springer paper reports the recombinant line out-yielded both parents and check genotypes in blind multilocation trials, but no cross-environment stability statistics were given.
agronomic_details.adaptation: Suitable for irrigated medium ecology (agronomic features in the variety record). Recommended state: Odisha.
agronomic_details.plant_characteristics: Non-lodging plant type with very strong culm. Non-shattering type. Fertilizer responsive (per agronomic features in the variety record). Semi-tall recombinant line carrying SD1 (per Springer paper).
agronomic_details.field_trials: Blind multilocation trials reported as the basis for release, in which the non-lodging semi-tall recombinant line out-yielded both parents and check genotypes (Springer paper). Plot-level agronomic data (seed rate, fertiliser, transplanting date) and farmer-field trial numbers were not found in searched sources.

genetics_and_breeding.genetic_markers: SD1 allele confirmed by molecular profiling in Naveen and its lines. SNP genotyping support credited to S. K. Dash of CRRI. Marker names beyond the SD1 allele, and any marker positions, were not found in searched sources.
genetics_and_breeding.qtl_information: Not found in searched sources. The Springer paper reports that Xa4 reduced lodging in semi-dwarf and taller lines; no QTL effect sizes were reported in the digest.
genetics_and_breeding.molecular_mechanisms: Bacterial blight resistance genes Xa4, xa5, Xa7, xa13 and Xa21 pyramided into Naveen using IRBB66 as donor. The released line is a recombinant carrying the Xa4 + xa5 + Xa7 + xa13 + Xa21 + SD1 combination, not a simple Naveen/IRBB66 cross. SD1 is the semi-dwarf allele; Xa4 is associated with improved lodging resistance.
